a: I savar la kerabbi yehuda ben betira — nema kevoteh! kasavar rabbi akiva: ki ketiv nissuch yattira — beshishshi hu dichtiv.

Tanya, rabbi natan omer: "bakkodesh hassech nesech shechar laAdonai", bishne nissuchin hakkatuv medabber, echad nissuch hammayim veechad nissuch hayyayin. ema tarvayyhu dechamra! im ken, lichtov kera o "hassech hesech", o "nassech nesech", may "hassech nesech" — shamat minna: chad demayya vechad dechamra.
Ella, ha ditnan: nissuch hammayim kol shiva, manni? i rabbi yehoshua — nema chad yoma, i rabbi akiva — tere yome, i rabbi yehuda ben betira — shitta yome!
Leolam rabbi yehuda ben betira hi, usevira leh kerabbi yehuda dematnitin. ditnan, rabbi yehuda omer: ballog haya menassech kol shemona. umappek rishon umeayyel shemini.
Umay shena rishon dela, dechi remizi mayim — besheni hu dirmizi; shemini name, ki remizi mayim — bishvii hu dirmizi!
Ella: rabbi yehoshua hi, venissuch hammayim kol shiva — hilcheta gemiri la,
Deamar rabbi amme amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi nechuneya ish bikat bet chortan: eser netiot, arava, venissuch hammayim — halacha lemoshe missinay.

Rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi yehoshua: haover lifne hatteva beyom tov haacharon shel chag — haacharon mazkir, harishon eno mazkir. beyom tov harishon shel pesach — harishon mazkir, haacharon eno mazkir.
He rabbi yehoshua? illema rabbi yehoshua dematnitin, ha amar: beyom tov haacharon shel chag hu mazkir.
Ella: rabbi yehoshua devarayyta, haamar: mishsheat hannachato.

Vetu, ha detanya, rabbi yehuda omer mishshum ben betira: haover lifne hatteva beyom tov haacharon shel chag — haacharon mazkir, he ben betira? ilema rabbi yehuda ben betira — ha amar: bashsheni bechag hu mazkir!
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: tehe berabbi yehoshua ben betira, zimnin dekare leh bishmeh, vezimnin dekare leh bishmeh deabba. veha mikkamme delismechuhu, veha levatar delismechuhu.
Tena: battal uvaruchot, lo chiyyeyvu chachamim lehazekir. veim ba lehazekir — mazkir. may tama? amar rabbi chanina: lefi sheen neetzarin.

Vetal menalan dela miatzar — dichtiv: "vayyomer eliyyahu hattishbi mittoshave gilad el achav chay Adonai elohe yisrael asher amadti lefanav im yihye hashshanim haelle tal umatar ki im lefi devari", uchetiv: "lech herae el achav veettena matar al pene haadama", veillu tal la kaamar leh, may tama — mishshum
b: Dela miatzar. vechi meachar dela miatzar, eliyyahu ishtevoe lema leh? hachi kaamar leh: afillu tal beracha name la ate. velayhdereh letal divracha? mishshum dela minnachra milleta.

Ella ruchot mena lan dela miatzri? amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi, deamar kera: "ki kearba ruchot hashshamayim perasti etchem neum Adonai". may kaamar lehu? illema hachi kaamar lehu hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael: devaddartinchu bearba ruche dealma, i hachi — "kearba"? "bearba" mibbee leh! ella hachi kaamar: keshem shei efshar laolam belo ruchot — kach i efshar laolam belo yisrael.
Amar rabbi chanina: hilkach, bimot hachamma: amar "mashshiv haruach" — en machazirin oto. amar "morid haggeshem" — machazirin oto.
Bimot haggeshamim: lo amar "mashshiv haruach" — en machazirin oto. lo amar "morid haggeshem" — machazirin oto. velo od, ella afillu amar "maavir haruach umafriach hattal" — en machazirin oto.
Tana: beavim uvaruchot lo chiyyeyvu chachamim lehazekir, veim ba lehazekir — mazkir, may tama — mishshum dela miatzri.

Vela miatzri? vehatane rav yosef: "veatzar et hashshamayim" — min heavim umin haruchot. atta omer min heavim umin haruchot, o eno ella min hammatar? keshehu omer "velo yihye matar" — hare matar amur, ha ma ani mekayyem "veatzar et hashshamayim" — min heavim umin haruchot.
Kashya ruchot aruchot, kashya avim aavim! avim aavim la kashya: ha — becharfe, ha — beafle.
Ruchot aruchot la kashya: ha — beruach metzuya, ha — beruach sheenah metzuya. ruach sheenah metzuya chazya leve dare! efshar benafvota.

Tana: heavim veharuchot sheniyyot lammatar. hechi dame? amar ulla, veittema rav yehuda: devatar mitra. lememra dimalleyuta hi? vehachtiv: "yitten Adonai et metar artzecha avak veafar", veamar ulla veittema rav yehuda: zika devatar mitra!
La kashya: ha daata nicha, ha daata razya. vei baet ema: ha demaale avak, ha dela maale avak.
Veamar rav yehuda: zika devatar mitra — kemitra. eva devatar mitra — kemitra. shimsha devatar mitra — kitre mitre. lemaote may? lemaote gilhe delelya, veshimsha devene karche.
Amar rava: mealle talga leture kechamsha mitre leara, shenneemar: "ki lashsheleg yomar heve aretz vegeshem matar vegeshem mitrot uzzo".
Veamar rava: talga — leture, mitra razya — leilane, mitra nicha — lefere,

a: Urepila — afillu lefartzida detute kala mahneya leh. may urepila — uru pile. veamar rava: hay tzureba merabbanan dame lefartzida detute kala, dechevan dinvat — nevat.

Veamar rava: hay tzureba merabbanan deratach — orayyta hu deka martecha leh, shenneemar: "halo cho devari kaesh neum Adonai", veamar rav ashe: kol talmid chacham sheeno kashe kabbarzel — eno talmid chacham, shenneemar: "uchefattish yefotzetz sala".

Amar leh rabbi abba lerav ashe: attun, mehatam matnitu la. anan, mehacha matnenan la, dichtiv: "eretz asher avaneha varzel", al tikre "avaneha", ella boneha. amar ravina: afillu hachi, mibbee leh leinish lemelaf nafsheh benichuta, shenneemar: "vehaser kaas millibbecha vegomer".

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: shelosha shaalu shello kahogen, lishnayim heshivuhu kahogen, leechad heshivuhu shello kahogen. veellu hen: eliezer eved avraham, veshaul ben kish, veyiftach haggiladi.
Eliezer eved avraham — dichtiv: "vehaya hannaara asher omar eleha hatti na chaddech vegomer", yachol afillu chiggeret, afillu soma. heshivu kahogen, venizdammena lo rivka.
Shaul ben kish — dichtiv: "vehaya haish asher yakkennu yasherennu hammelech osher gadol veet bitto yitten lo", yachol afillu eved, afillu mamzer. heshivu kahogen, venizdammen lo david.
Yiftach haggiladi — dichtiv: "vehaya hayyotze asher yetze middalte veti vegomer", yachol afillu davar tame. heshivu shello kahogen, nizdammena lo bitto.
Vehayeynu dekaamar lehu navi leyisrael: "hatzori en begilad im rofe en sham".
Uchetiv: "asher lo tzivviti velo dibbarti velo alta al libbi",

"Asher lo tzivveti" — ze beno shel mesha melech moav, shenneemar: "vayyikkach et beno habbechor asher yimloch tachtav vayyaalehu ola"; "velo dibbarti" — ze yiftach; "velo alta al libbi" — ze yitzchak ben avraham.
Amar rabbi berechya: af keneset yisrael shaala shello kahogen, vehakkadosh baruch hu heshivah kahogen, shenneemar: "veneda nirdefa ladaat et Adonai keshachar nachon motzao veyavo chaggeshem lanu",
Amar lah hakkadosh baruch hu: bitti, at shoelet davar sheppeamim mitbakkesh ufeamim eno mitbakkesh, aval ani ehye lach davar hammitbakkesh leolam, shenneemar: "ehye chattal leyisrael".

Veod shaala shello kahogen, amra lefanav: ribbono shel olam! "simeni chachotam al libbecha kachotam al zeroecha", amar lah hakkadosh baruch hu: bitti, at shoelet davar sheppeamim nire ufeamim eno nire, aval ani eese lach davar shennire leolam, shenneemar: "hen al kappayim chakkotich".
En shoalin et haggeshamim kulei. savruha: sheela vehazekara chada milleta hi, man tanna? amar rava: rabbi yehoshua hi, deamar mishsheat hannachato.
Amar leh abbaye: afillu tema rabbi eliezer — sheela lechud, vehazekara lechud.
Veikka deamri: lema
b: Rabbi yehoshua hi, deamar mishsheat hannachato?! amar rava: afillu tema rabbi eliezer — sheela lechud, vehazekara lechud.
Rabbi yehuda omer: haover lifne hatteva kulei.
Ureminhu: ad matay shoalin et haggeshamim, rabbi yehuda omer: ad sheyyaavor happesach, rabbi meir omer: ad sheyyaavor nisan.
Amar rav chisda, la kashya: kan lishol, kan lehazekir. mishal — shael veazel, lehazekir — beyom tov harishon pasek.
Amar ulla: ha derav chisda kashya kachometz lashshinnayim vecheashan laenayim. uma bimkom sheeno shoel — mazkir, bimkom sheshshoel, eno din sheyyehe mazkir?
Ella amar ulla: tere tannae allibba derabbi yehuda.
Rav yosef amar: may "ad sheyyaavor happesach" — ad sheyyaavor sheliach tzibbur rishon hayyored beyom tov rishon shel pesach.
Amar leh abbaye: sheela beyom tov mi ikka?
Amar leh: in shoel meturegman. vechi meturegman shoel davar sheeno tzarich latztzibbur? ella mechavvavrta, kidulla.
Rabba amar: may "ad sheyyaavor happesach" — ad sheyyaavor zeman shechitat happesach. vechitchillato ken sofo: ma techillato — mazkir af al pi sheeno shoel, af sofo — mazkir af al pi sheeno shoel.
Amar leh abbaye: bishlama techillato mazkir — hazekara name ritztzuy sheela hi, ella sofo, may ritztzuy sheela ikka? ella mechavvavrta kidulla.

Amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kerabbi yehuda. amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi assi: umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi? vehatnan: bishlosha bemarcheshvon shoalin et haggeshamim, rabban gamliel omer: beshiva bo. veamar rabbi elazar: halacha kerabban gamliel!
Amar leh: gavra aggavra ka ramet?! ibbaet ema, la kashya: kan lishol, kan lehazekir.
Vehaamar rabbi yochanan: bimkom sheshshoel mazkir! hahu lehafesaka ittemar. vehaamar rabbi yochanan: hitchil lehazekir — matchil lishol, pasak millishol — posek millehazkir.
Ella, la kashya: ha lan, ha lehu. may shena ledidan — deit lan pere bedavra, ledidhu name it lehu ole regalim!
Ki kaamar rabbi yochanan, bizman sheen bet hammikdash kayyaym. hasheta deatet lehachi — ha veha ledidhu, vela kashya: kan bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym, kan bizman sheen bet hammikdash kayyaym.
Vaanan deit lan tere yome, hechi avdinan? amar rav: matchil bemusafin, ufosek bemincha arvit veshacharit, vechozer bemusafin.
Amar lehu shemuel, puku veemaru leh leabba: achar sheasito kodesh taasehu chol? ella amar shemuel: matchil bemusafin uvemincha, ufosek arvit veshacharit, vechozer umatchil bemusafin.

a: Rava amar: kevan shehitchil, shuv eno posek. vechen amar rav sheshet: kevan shehitchil, shuv eno posek.

Veaf rav hadar beh. deamar rav chananel amar rav: mone esrim veechad yom kederech shemmone asara yamim merosh hashshana ad yom hakkippurim, umatchil, vechevan shehitchil — shuv eno posek. vehilcheta: kevan shehitchil, shuv eno posek.
Mishna ad matay shoalin et haggeshamim? rabbi yehuda omer: ad sheyyaavor happesach, rabbi meir omer: ad sheyyetze nisan, shenneemar: "vayyored lachem geshem more umalkosh barishon".

Gemara amar leh rav nachman lerabbi yitzchak: yore benisan? yore bimrachshevan hu! ditnan: yore bimrachshevan umalkosh benisan! amar leh, hachi amar rabbi yochanan: bime yoel ben petuel nitkayyem mikra ze dichtiv beh "yeter haggazam achal haarbe vegomer". otah shana yatza adar velo yardu geshamim, yarda lahem revia rishona beechad benisan.

Amar lahem navi leyisrael: tzeu veziru! amru lo: mi sheyyesh lo kav chittim o kabbayyim seorin — yochlennu veyichye, o yizraennu veyamut? amar lahem: af al pi chen tzeu veziru. naasa lahem nes, venitgalla lahem ma shebbakketalin uma shebbechore nemalim.

Yatzu vezaru sheni ushelishi urevii, veyarda lahem revia sheniyya bachamishsha benisan. hikrivu omer beshishsha asar benisan, nimtzet tevua haggedela beshishsha chodashim, gedela beachad asar yom. nimtza omer hakkarev mittevua shel shishsha chodashim, karev mittevua shel achad asar yom.

Veal oto haddor hu omer: "hazzorim bedima berinna yiktzoru. haloch yelech uvacho nose meshech hazzara vegomer". may "haloch yelech uvacho nose meshech vegomer"? amar rabbi yehuda: shor, keshehu choresh — holech uvoche, uvachazirato — ochel chaziz min hattelem. vezehu: "bo yavo berinna".
May "nose alummotav"? amar rav chisda, veamri la bematnita tana: kane zeret, shibbolet zirtayim.
Amar leh rav nachman lerabbi yitzchak, may dichtiv: "ki kara Adonai laraav vegam ba el haaretz sheva shanim", behanach sheva shanim may achul?

Amar leh, hachi amar rabbi yochanan: shana rishona achlu ma shebbabbattim, sheniyya achlu ma shebbassadot, shelishit besar behema tehora, reviit besar behema temea, chamishit besar shekatzim uremasim, shishshit besar benehem uvenotehem, sheviit besar zerootehem, lekayyem ma shenneemar: "ish besar zeroo yochelu".

Vaamar leh rav nachman lerabbi yitzchak, may dichtiv: "bekirbecha kadosh velo avo beir", mishshum divkirbecha kadosh lo avo beir? amar leh: hachi amar rabbi yochanan, amar hakkadosh baruch hu: lo avo birushalayim shel mala ad sheavo lirushalayim shel matta!
Umi ikka yerushalayim lemala? in, dichtiv: "yerushalaym habbenuya keir shechubbera lah yachdav".

Vaamar leh rabbi nachman lerabbi yitzchak, may dichtiv: "uveachat yivaru veyichsalu musar havalim etz hu"? amar leh, hachi amar rabbi yochanan: achat hi shemmevaeret reshaim begehinnam, may hi — avoda zara. ketiv hacha: "musar havalim etz hu", uchetiv hatam: "hevel hemma maase tatuim".
Vaamar leh rav nachman lerabbi yitzchak, may dichtiv: "ki shetayim raot asa ammi", tarten hu dahavo? esrin vearba shevika lehu? amar leh, hachi amar rabbi yochanan: achat shehi
b: Shekula kishtayim, umay nihu — avoda zara, dichtiv: "ki shetayim raot asa ammi oti azvu mekor mayim chayyim lachtzov lahem borot borot nishbarim", uchetiv behu: "ki ivru iyye chittiyyim ureu vekedar shilchu vehitbonnu meod vegomer hahemir goy elohim vehemma lo elohim veammi hemir kevodo belo yoil".
Tana: kutiyyim ovdim laesh, vekedariyyim ovdin lammayim, veaf al pi sheyyodim shehammayim mechabbin et haesh — lo hemiru elohehem, "veammi hemir kevodo belo yoil".

Vaamar leh rav nachman lerabbi yitzchak, may dichtiv: "vayhi kaasher zaken shemuel", umi siv shemuel kulle hay? veha bar chamishshim ushetayim hava, deamar mar: met bachamishshim ushetayim shana, zehu mitato shel shemuel haramati.

Amar leh, hachi amar rabbi yochanan: zikna kaftza alav, dichtiv: "nichamti ki himlachti et shaul". amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam! shekaltani kemoshe veaharon, dichtiv: "moshe veaharon bechohanav ushemuel bekore shemo", ma moshe veaharon lo batlu maase yedehem bechayyehem, af ani lo yitbattel maase yaday bechayyay.

Amar hakkadosh baruch hu: hechi eeved? lemut shaul — la ka shavek shemuel, lemut shemuel addezutar — meranneni abbatreh. la lemut shaul vela lemut shemuel — kevar higgia malchut david, veen malchut nogaat bachavertah afillu kimlo nima.

Amar hakkadosh baruch hu: akpitz alav zikna. hayeynu dichtiv: "veshaul yoshev baggiva tachat haeshel barama", vechi ma inyan giva etzel rama? ella lomar lecha: mi garam leshaul sheyyashav baggiva shete shanim umechetza — tefillato shel shemuel haramati.

Umi middeche gavra mikkamme gavra? in, deamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yochanan: may dichtiv: "al ken chatzavti banneviim haragtim beimre fi" — "bemaasehem" lo neemar, ella "beimre fi", alma: middeche gavra mikkamme gavra.

Rav nachman verabbi yitzchak havo yatvi bisudeta. amar leh rav nachman lerabbi yitzchak: lema mar milleta. amar leh, hachi amar rabbi yochanan: en mesichin bisuda, shemma yakdim kane leveshet veyavo lide sakkana.

Batar disud amar leh, hachi amar rabbi yochanan: yaakov avinu lo met. amar leh: vechi bichdi sefadu safdanayya vachanatu chantayyay ukevaru kabbarayyay? amar leh: mikra ani doresh, shenneemar: "veatta al tira avdi yaakov neum Adonai veal techat yisrael ki hinni moshiacha merachok veet zaracha meeretz shivyam", makkish hu lezaro: ma zaro bachayyim — af hu bachayyim.
Amar rabbi yitzchak: kol haomer "rachav" "rachav" miyyad nikre. amar leh rav nachman: ana amena vela ichpat li! amar leh: ki kaamena, beyodah uvemakkirah.

Ki havo mippatri mehadade, amar leh: livarchan mar! amar leh: emshol lecha mashal, lema haddavar dome? leadam shehaya holech bammidbar vehaya raev veayef vetzame, umatza ilan shepperotav metukin vetzillo nae veammat hammayim overet tachtav. achal mipperotav, veshata mimmemav, veyashav betzillo.

Ucheshebbikkesh lelech, amar: ilan ilan, bamma avarechcha? im omar lecha sheyyehu perotecha metukin — hare perotecha metukin, sheyyehe tzillecha nae — hare tzillecha nae, shettehe ammat hammayim overet tachtecha — hare ammat hammayim overet tachtecha, ella: yehi ratzon shekkol netiot shennotin mimmecha

a: Yihyu kemotcha. af atta, bamma avarechcha? im betora — hare tora, im beosher — hare osher, im bevanim — hare banim, ella: yehi ratzon sheyyihyu tzeetzae meecha kemotcha.

Tanu rabbanan: "yore" — shemmore et habberiyyot lehatiach gaggotehen, ulehachnis et perotehen, velaasot kol tzorchehen. davar acher: shemmarve et haaretz umashkah ad tehom, shenneemar: "telameha ravve nachet gedudeha birvivim temoggenna tzimchah tevarech". davar acher: "yore" — sheyyored benachat veeno yored bezaaf.

O eno "yore", ella shemmashshir et happerot, umashtif et hazzeraim, umashtif et hailanot — talmud lomar: "malkosh", ma malkosh livracha — af yore livracha. o eno "malkosh", ella shemmappil et habbattim, umeshabber et hailanot, umaale et hassakkain — talmud lomar: "yore", ma yore livracha — af malkosh livracha.
Veyore gufeh menalan — dichtiv: "uvene tziyyon gilu vesimchu baAdonai elohechem ki natan lachem et hammore litzdaka vayyored lachem geshem more umalkosh barishon".
Tanu rabbanan: yore bimrachshevan, umalkosh benisan. atta omer: yore bimrachshevan umalkosh benisan, o eno ella yore betishri umalkosh beiyyayr? talmud lomar: "beitto".

"Malkosh" — amar rav nehilay bar idde amar shemuel: davar shemmal kashyutehen shel yisrael. deve rabbi yishmael tana: davar shemmemalle tevua bekashsheha. bematnita tana: davar sheyyored al hammelilot veal hakkashshin.

Tanu rabbanan: yore bimrachshevan, umalkosh benisan. atta omer yore bimrachshevan, o eno ella bechodesh kislev? talmud lomar: "beitto yore umalkosh", ma malkosh beitto — af yore beitto, kevan sheyyatza nisan veyardu geshamim eno siman beracha.
Tanya iddach: yore bimrachshevan umalkosh benisan, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: yore bechislev.

Man chachamim? amar rav chisda: rabbi yose hi, detanya: ezo hi revia rishona? habbechira — bishlosha bimrachshevan, benonit — beshiva bo, afila — beshiva asar bo, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: beshiva, uveshiva asar, uveesrim ushelosha.
Rabbi yose omer: beshiva asar, uveesrim ushelosha, uverosh chodesh kislev. vechen haya rabbi yose omer: en hayyechidim mitannin ad sheyyaggia rosh chodesh kislev.

Amar rav chisda: halacha kerabbi yose. ammemar matne leha derav chisda beha lishshana: bishlosha bimrachshevan shoalin et haggeshamim, rabban gamliel omer: beshiva bo, amar rav chisda: halacha kerabban gamliel.

Keman azla ha detanya, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: geshamim sheyyardu shiva yamim ze achar ze atta mone bahen revia rishona usheniyya ushelishit, keman — kerabbi yose. amar rav chisda: halacha kerabbi yose.
Bishlama revia rishona — lishol. shelishit — lehitannot. sheniyya, lemay? amar rabbi zera: lindarim, ditnan:
b: Hannoder ad haggeshamim — mishsheyyerdu geshamim ad shettered revia sheniyya.

Rav zevid amar: lezetim. ditnan: meematay kol adam muttarin beleket beshichcha uvefea — mishsheyyelchu hannamoshot. beferet uveolelot — mishsheyyelchu aniyyim bakkerem veyavou. bezetim — mishshettered revia sheniyya.
May "namoshot"? amar rabbi yochanan: save deazli attigra. resh lakish amar: lakote batar lakote.
Rav pappa amar: kede lehallech bishvile harshut. deamar mar: mehallechin kol adam bishvile harshut — ad shettered revia sheniyya.
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: levaer perot sheviit. ditnan: ad matay nehenin vesorfin beteven uvekash shel sheviit — ad shettered revia sheniyya.
May tama? dichtiv: "velivhemtecha velachayya asher beartzecha", kol zeman shechayya ochelet bassade — haachel livhemtecha babbayit. kala lachayya min hassade — kalle livhemtecha min habbayit.

Amar rabbi avahu: may leshon "revia" — davar sherovea et hakkarka. kidrav yehuda, deamar rav yehuda: mitra bala deara hu, shenneemar: "ki kaasher yered haggeshem vehashsheleg min hashshamayim veshamma lo yashuv ki im hirva et haaretz veholidah vehitzmichah".
Veamar rabbi avahu: revia rishona — kede shettered bakkarka tefach. sheniyya — kede laguf bah pi chavit. amar rav chisda: geshamim sheyyardu kede laguf bahen pi chavit en bahen mishshum "veatzar".
Veamar rav chisda: geshamim sheyyardu kodem "veatzar", en bahen mishshum "veatzar".

Amar abbaye: la amaran ella kodem "veatzar" deureta, aval kodem "veatzar" detzafra — yesh bahen mishshum "veatzar". deamar rav yehuda bar yitzchak: hane anane detzafra let behu meshasha, dichtiv: "ma eese lecha efrayim ma eese lecha yehuda vechasdechem kaanan boker vegomer".
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye, veha amri inashe: bemiftach bave mitra — bar chammara much sakkach ugeni! la kashya: ha diktir beeva, ha diktir baanane.

Amar rav yehuda: tava leshatta detevet armalta. ikka deamri: dela bayyri tarbitze, veikka deamri: dela shekil shudefana. ini? vehaamar rav chisda: tava leshatta detevet menavvavlta! la kashya: ha daata mitra meikkara, ha dela ata mitra meikkara.

Veamar rav chisda: geshamim sheyyardu al miktzat medina veal miktzat medina lo yardu — en bahen mishshum "veatzar". ini? vehachtiv: "vegam anochi manati mikkem et haggeshem beod shelosha chodashim lakkatzir vehimtarti al ir echat veal ir achat lo amtir chelka achat timmater vegomer", veamar rav yehuda amar rav: shetehen liklala!
La kashya: ha daata tuva, ha daata kidmibbee leh. amar rav ashe: dayka name, dichtiv: "timmater" — tehe mekom matar. shema minna.
Amar rabbi avahu: meematay mevarchin al haggeshamim — mishsheyyetze chatan likrat kalla.

May mevarech? amar rav yehuda amar rav: "modim anachnu lach Adonai elohenu al kol tippa vetippa shehoradta lanu". verabbi yochanan mesayyem ba hachi: "illu finu male shira kayyam uleshonenu rinna kahamon gallav kulei", ad "al yazevunu rachamecha Adonai elohenu velo azavunu, baruch rov hahodaot".
"Rov hahodaot" velo "kol hahodaot"? amar rava, ema: "el hahodaot". amar rav pappa: hilkach

a: Nemrinhu letarvayyhu: "el hahodaot" verov hahodaot".

Amar rabbi avahu: gadol yom haggeshamim mittechiyyayt hammetim, deillu techiyyayt hammetim — latztzaddikim, veillu geshamim — ben latztzaddikim ben larshaim. ufeliga derav yosef, deamar rav yosef: mittoch shehi shekula kitchiyyayt hammetim — kevauha bitchiyyayt hammetim.

Amar rav yehuda: gadol yom haggeshamim keyom shennittena bo tora, shenneemar: "yaarof kammatar likchi", veen "lekach" ella tora, shenneemar: "ki lekach tov natatti lachem torati al taazovu". rava amar: yoter miyyom shennittena bo tora, shenneemar: "yaarof kammatar likchi", mi nitle bemi? heve omer: katan nitle baggadol.
Rava rame, ketiv: "yaarof kammatar likchi", uchetiv: "tizzal kattal imrati"! im talmid chacham hagun hu — kattal, veim lav — orfehu kammatar.

Tanya, haya rabbi benaa omer: kol haosek betora lishmah — torato naaset lo sam chayyim, shenneemar: "etz chayyim hi lammachazikim bah", veomer: "rifut tehi lesharecha", veomer: "ki motzi matza chayyim". vechol haosek battora shello lishmah — naaset lo sam hammavet, shenneemar: "yaarof kammatar likchi", veen arifa ella hariga, shenneemar: "vearfu sham et haegla bannachal".

Amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zera: lete mar litne. amar leh: chalash libbay vela yachelna. lema mar milleta deaggadta, amar leh: hachi amar rabbi yochanan — may dichtiv: "ki haadam etz hassade", vechi adam etz sade hu?

Ella, mishshum dichtiv: "ki mimmennu tochel veoto lo tichrot", uchetiv: "oto tashchit vecharatta". ha ketzad? im talmid chacham hagun hu — "mimmennu tochel veoto lo tichrot", veim lav — "oto tashchit vecharatta".
Amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina, may dichtiv: "barzel bevarzel yachad", lomar lach: ma barzel ze — echad mechadded et chavero, af shene talmide chachamim — mechaddedin ze et ze bahalacha.
Amar rabba bar bar chana: lamma nimshelu divre tora kaesh, shenneemar: "halo cho devari kaesh neum Adonai", lomar lach: ma esh eno dolek yechidi, af divre tora en mitkayyeymin bichidi.

Vehayeynu deamar rabbi yose bar chanina, may dichtiv: "cherev el habbaddim venoalu", cherev al sonehen shel talmide chachamim sheoskin bad bevad battora. velo od ella shemmittappeshin, shenneemar: "venoalu".
Velo od, ella shechotin. ketiv hacha: "venoalu", uchetiv hatam: "asher noalnu vaasher chatanu". veibbaet ema — mehacha: "noalu sare tzoan [vegomer] hitu et mitzrayim".

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: lamma nimshelu divre tora keetz, shenneemar: "etz chayyim hi lammachazikim bah", lomar lach: ma etz katan madlik et haggadol, af talmide chachamim ketannim mechaddedim et haggedolim. vehayeynu deamar rabbi chanina: harebe lamadti merabbotay, umechaveray yoter merabbotay, umittalmiday yoter mikkullan.
Rabbi chanina bar pappa rame: ketiv "likrat tzame hetayu mayim", uchetiv: "hoy kol tzame lechu lammayim". im talmid hagun hu — "likrat tzame hetayu mayim", vei la — "hoy kol tzame lechu lammayim".
Rabbi chanina bar chama rame: ketiv "yafutzu mayenotecha chutza", uchetiv: "yihyu lecha levaddecha". im talmid hagun hu — "yafutzu mayenotecha chutza", veim lav — "yihyu lecha levaddecha".

Veamar rabbi chanina bar idi: lamma nimshelu divre tora lemayim, dichtiv: "hoy kol tzame lechu lammayim", lomar lach: ma mayim mannichin makom gavoah veholchin lemakom namuch, af divre tora en mitkayyeymin ella bemi sheddato shefala.

Veamar rabbi oshaya: lamma nimshelu divre tora lishlosha mashkin hallalu: bemayim, uveyayin, uvechalav. dichtiv: "hoy kol tzame lechu lammayim", uchetiv: "lechu shivru veecholu ulechu shivru belo chesef uvelo mechir yayin vechalav", lomar lach: ma shelosha mashkin hallalu en mitkayyeymin ella bappachut shebbakkelim — af divre tora en mitkayyeymin ella bemi sheddato shefala.

Kedaamara leh beratte dekesar lerabbi yehoshua ben chananya: i chochma mefoara bichli mechoar! amar la: avicha rame chamra bemane defachra? amara leh: ella bemay nirme? amar la: attun dachashivitu, remo bemane dahava vechaspa.

Azala vaamara leh laavu ramyeh lechamra bemane dahava vechaspa, utekef. ato vaamaru leh. amar la livratteh: man amar lach hachi? amara leh: rabbi yehoshua ben chananya. karyuhu. amar leh: ammay amart la hachi? amar leh: ki hechi daamara li, amari la. veha ikka shappire digmiri!
b: I havo senu — tefe havo gemiri. davar acher: ma shelosha mashkin hallalu en nifsalin ella behessach haddaat — af divre tora en mishtachchin ella behessach haddaat.

Amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: gadol yom haggeshamim keyom shennivreu shamayim vaaretz, shenneemar: "hareifu shamayim mimmaal ushechakim yizzelu tzedek tiftach eretz veyifru yesha utzedaka tatzmiach yachad ani Adonai berativ". "beratim" lo neemar, ella "berativ".

Amar rav oshaya: gadol yom haggeshamim, sheafillu yeshua para verava bo, shenneemar: "tiftach eretz veyifru yesha". amar rabbi tanchum bar chanilay: en haggeshamim yordim ella im ken nimchalu avonotehen shel yisrael, shenneemar: "ratzita Adonai artzecha shavta shevit yaakov. nasata avon ammecha kissita chol chattatam sela".
Amar leh zeeri middihavat leravina: attun, mehacha matnitu la. anan, mehacha matnenan la: "veatta tishma hashshamayim vesalachta lechattat vegomer".

Amar rabbi tanchum bereh derabbi chiyyay ish kefar akko: en haggeshamim neetzarin ella im ken nitchayyeyvu sonehen shel yisrael kelaya, shenneemar: "tziyya gam chom yigzelu meme sheleg sheol chatau". amar leh zeeri middihavat leravina: attun, mehacha matnitu la. anan, mehacha matnenan la: "veatzar et hashshamayim vaavadtem mehera".

Amar rav chisda: en haggeshamim neetzarin ella bishvil bittul terumot umaasrot, shenneemar: "tziyya gam chom yigzelu meme sheleg". may mashma? tana deve rabbi yishmael: bishvil devarim shetztzivviti etchem bimot hachamma velo asitem — yiggazlu mikkem meme sheleg bimot haggeshamim.
Amar rabbi shimon ben pazzi: en haggeshamim neetzarin ella bishvil mesappere lashon hara, shenneemar: "ruach tzafon techolel gashem ufanim nizamim leshon sater".

Amar rav salla amar rav hamenuna: en haggeshamim neetzarin ella bishvil azze fanim, shenneemar: "vayyimmanu revivim umalkosh lo haya umetzach ishsha zona haya lach vegomer". veamar rav salla amar rav hamenuna: kol adam sheyyesh lo azzut panim — sof nichshal baavera, shenneemar: "umetzach ishsha zona haya lach". rav nachman amar: beyadua shennichshal baavera, shenneemar: "haya lach", velo neemar "yihye lach".

Amar rabba bar rav huna: kol adam sheyyesh lo azzut panim — muttar likroto rasha, shenneemar: "heez ish rasha befanav". rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: muttar lisnooto, shenneemar: "veoz panav yeshunne". al tikre "yeshunne", ella "yissane".

Amar rav kattina: en haggeshamim neetzarin ella bishvil bittul tora, shenneemar: "baatzaltayim yimmach hammekare" — bishvil atzlut shehaya beyisrael shello asku battora — naase sono shel hakkadosh baruch hu mach. veen "mach" ella ani, shenneemar: "veim mach hu meerkecha". veen "mekare" ella hakkadosh baruch hu, shenneemar: "hamekare vammayim aliyyotav".

Rav yosef amar, mehacha: "veatta lo rau or bahir hu bashshechakim veruach avra vattetaharem", veen "or" ella tora, shenneemar: "ki ner mitzva vetora or" — "bahir hu bashshechakim". tana deve rabbi yishmael: afillu beshaa sherakia naase behorin behorin lehorid tal umatar — "ruach avra vattetaharem".

Amar rabbi amme: en haggeshamim neetzarin ella baavon gazel, shenneemar: "al kappayim kissa or". baavon kappayim — kissa or. veen "kappayim" ella chamas, shenneemar: "umin hechamas asher bechappehem", veen "or" ella matar, shenneemar: "yafitz anan oro".
May takkanteh — yarbe bitfilla, shenneemar: "vaytzav aleha bemafgia", veen "pegia" ella tefilla, shenneemar: "veatta al titpallel bead haam hazze vegomer veal tifga bi".

Veamar rabbi amme, may dichtiv: "im keha habbarzel vehu lo fanim kilkal", im raita rakia shekkeha kabbarzel millehorid tal umatar — bishvil maase haddor shehen mekulekalin, shenneemar: "vehu lo fanim kilkal".
Ma takkanatan — yitgabberu berachamim, shenneemar: "vachayalim yegabber veyitron hachesher chochma", kol shekken im hucheshru maasehen meikkara.
Resh lakish amar: im raita talmid

a: Shettalmudo kashe alav kabbarzel — bishvil mishnato sheenah sedura alav, shenneemar: "vehu lo fanim kilkal".
May takkanteh — yarbe bishiva, shenneemar: "vachayalim yegabber veyitron hachesher chochma". kol shekken im mishnato sedura lo meikkara.

Ki ha deresh lakish hava mesaddar matniteh arbein zimnin, keneged arbaim yom shennittena tora, veayel lekammeh derabbi yochanan. rav adda bar ahava mesaddar matniteh esrin vearba zimnin, keneged tora neviim uchetuvim, veayel lekammeh derava.
Rava amar: im raita talmid shettalmudo kashe alav kabbarzel — bishvil rabbo sheeno masbir lo panim, shenneemar: "vehu lo fanim kilkal".
May takkanteh — yarbe alav reim, shenneemar: "vachayalim yegabber veyitron hachesher chochma". kol shekken im hucheshru maasav bifne rabbo meikkara.

Veamar rabbi amme, may dichtiv: "im yishshoch hannachash belo lachash veen yitron levaal hallashon", im raita dor shehashshamayim mishtakkin kinchoshet millehorid tal umatar — bishvil lochashe lechishot sheen baddor.
May takkanatan — yelchu etzel mi sheyyodea lilchosh, dichtiv: "yaggid alav reo", "veen ytron levaal hallashon". umi sheefshar lo lilchosh veeno lochesh, ma hanaa yesh lo?

Veim lachash velo naana, may takkanteh? yelech etzel chasid shebbaddor, veyarbe alav bitfilla, shenneemar: "vaytzav aleha bemafgia", veen pegia ella tefilla, shenneemar: "veatta al titpallel bead haam hazze veal tissa vaadam rinna utefilla veal tifga bi".
Veim lachash vealta beyado, umegis dato alav — mevi af laolam, shenneemar: "mikne af al ole".
Rava amar: shene talmide chachamim sheyyoshvin beir achat veen nochin ze laze bahalacha — mitkannein baaf umaalin oto, shenneemar: "mikne af al ole".

Amar resh lakish, may dichtiv: "im yishshoch hannachash belo lachash veen yitron levaal hallashon", leatid lavo mitkabbetzot uvaot kol hachayyot etzel hannachash, veomrim lo: ari dores veochel, zeev toref veochel, atta ma hanaa yesh lecha? omer lahem: "veen yitron levaal hallashon".

Amar rabbi amme: en tefillato shel adam nishmaat ella im ken mesim nafsho bechappo, shenneemar: "nissa levavenu el kappayim", ini?! veha okem shemuel amora aleh uderash: "vayfattuhu befihem uvilshonam yechazzevu lo velibbam lo nachon immo velo neemnu bivrito", veaf al pi chen — "vehu rachum yechapper avon vegomer"!
La kashya: kan beyachid, kan betzibbur.
Amar rabbi amme: en geshamim yordin ella bishvil baale amana, shenneemar: "emet meeretz titzmach vetzedek mishshamayim nishkaf".
Veamar rabbi amme: bo uree kamma gedolim baale amana, minnayin — mechuleda uvor. uma hammaamin bechuleda uvor — kach, hammaamin behakkadosh baruch hu — al achat kamma vechamma.

Amar rabbi yochanan: kol hammatzdik et atzmo millematta — matzdikin alav haddin millemala, shenneemar: "emet meeretz titzmach vetzedek mishshamayim nishkaf". rabbi chiyyay bar avin amar rav huna, mehacha: "ucheyiratcha evratecha".

Resh lakish amar mehacha: "pagata et sas veose tzedek bidrachecha yizkerucha hen atta katzafta vannecheta bahem olam venivvashea". amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol hassameach beyissurin shebbain alav — mevi yeshua laolam, shenneemar: "bahem olam venivvashea".

Amar resh lakish, may dichtiv: "veatzar et hashshamayim", beshaa shehashshamayim neetzarin millehorid tal umatar — dome leishsha shemmechabbelet veenah yoledet. vehayeynu deamar resh lakish mishshum bar kappara: neemra atzira bigshamim veneemra atzira beishsha,
b: Neemra atzira beishsha, shenneemar: "ki atzor atzar Adonai bead kol rechem", veneemra atzira bigshamim, dichtiv: "veatzar et hashshamayim".
Neemar leda beishsha veneemar leda bigshamim, neemar leda beishsha, dichtiv: "vattahar vatteled ben", veneemar leda bigshamim, dichtiv: "veholidah vehitzmichah".

Neemar pekida beishsha, veneemar pekida bigshamim. neemar pekida beishsha, dichtiv: "vaAdonai pakad et sara", veneemar pekida bigshamim, dichtiv: "pakadta haaretz vatteshokkeha rabbat tasherenna peleg elohim male mayim".
May "peleg elohim male mayim"? tana: kemin kubba yesh barakia, shemmimmenna geshamim yotzin.
Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani, may dichtiv: "im leshevet im leartzo im lechesed yamtziehu". "im leshevet" — beharim uvigvaot, "im lechesed yamtziehu leartzo" — besadot uvichramim.
"Im leshevet" — leilanot, "im leartzo" — lizraim, "im lechesed yamtziehu" — borot shichin umearot.

Bime rabbi shemuel bar nachmani hava kafna umotana, amri: hechi naaved? nive rachame attarte — la efshar. ella live rachame ammotana, vechafna nisbol. amar lehu rabbi shemuel bar nachmani: nive rachame akkafna, dechi yahev rachamana suvea — lechayye hu deyahev, dichtiv: "poteach et yadecha umasbia lechol chay ratzon".

Umenalan dela metzallinan attarte — dichtiv: "vannatzuma vannevaksha meelohenu al zot", mikkelal deikka achariti. bemareva amri mishshemeh derabbi chaggay mehacha: "verachamin lemive min kodam elah shemayya al raza dena", mikkelal deikka achariti.
Bime rabbi zera gezur shemada, ugezur dela lemetav betaanita. amar lehu rabbi zera: nekabbeleh illavavn, ulechi batel shemada letveh.
Amri leh: mena lach ha? amar lehu, dichtiv: "vayyomer elay al tira daniyyel ki min hayyom harishon asher natatta et libbecha lehavin ulehitannot lifne elohecha nishmeu devarecha".

Amar rabbi yitzchak: afillu shanim kishne eliyyahu, veyardu geshamim bearve shabbatot — enan ella siman kelala. hayeynu deamar rabba bar shela: kashe yoma demitra keyoma dedina. amar ammemar: i la ditzrich livriyyayta, baenan rachame umevattelinan leh.

Veamar rabbi yitzchak: shemesh beshabbat — tzedaka laaniyyim, shenneemar: "vezarcha lachem yire shemi shemesh tzedaka umarpe". veamar rabbi yitzchak: gadol yom haggeshamim, sheafillu peruta shebbakkis mitbarechet bo, shenneemar: "latet metar artzecha beitto ulevarech et kol maase yadecha".

Veamar rabbi yitzchak: en habberacha metzuya ella bedavar hassamuy min haayin, shenneemar: "yetzav Adonai ittecha et habberacha baasamecha". tana deve rabbi yishmael: en habberacha metzuya ella bedavar sheen haayin sholetet bo, shenneemar: "yetzav Adonai ittecha et habberacha baasamecha".

Tanu rabbanan: hannichnas lamod et gorno, omer: "yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohenu shettishlach beracha bemaase yadenu". hitchil lamod, omer: "baruch hashsholeach beracha bakkeri hazze". madad veachar kach berach — hare zo tefillat shav, lefi sheen habberacha metzuya lo bedavar hashshakul, velo bedavar hammadud, velo bedavar hammanuy, ella bedavar hassamuy min haayin.

Kibbutz, geyaysot, tzedaka, maaser, parnas siman. amar rabbi yochanan: gadol yom haggeshamim keyom kibbutz galiyyot, shenneemar: "shuva Adonai et shevitenu kaafikim bannegev", veen "afikim" ella matar, shenneemar: "vayyerau afike yam".

Veamar rabbi yochanan: gadol yom haggeshamim, sheafillu geyaysot poskot bo, shenneemar: "telameha ravve nachet gedudeha". veamar rabbi yochanan: en haggeshamim neetzarin ella bishvil poske tzedaka barabbim veen notnin, shenneemar: "nesiim veruach vegeshem ayin ish mithallel bemattat shaker".
Veamar rabbi yochanan, may dichtiv:

a: "Asser teasser" — asser bishvil shettitashsher.

Ashkecheh rabbi yochanan leyanoka deresh lakish, amar leh: imma li pesukaych! amar leh: "asser teasser". amar leh: umay "asser teasser"? amar leh: asser bishvil shettitashsher, amar leh: mena lach? amar leh: zil nassi.

Amar leh: umi shere lenassoyeh lehakkadosh baruch hu? vehachtiv: "lo tenassu et Adonai"! amar leh, hachi amar rabbi hoshaya: chutz mizzo, shenneemar: "haviu et kol hammaaser el bet haotzar vihi teref beveti uvechanuni na bazot amar Adonai tzevaot im lo eftach lachem et arubbot hashshamayim vaharikoti lachem beracha ad beli day".
May "ad beli day"? amar rame bar chama amar rav: ad sheyyivlu siftotechem millomar "day". amar leh: i havat mate hatam lehay pesuka, la havet tzerichna lach ulehoshaya rabbach.
Vetu ashkecheh rabbi yochanan leyanokeh deresh lakish deyatev veamar: "ivvelet adam tesallef darko veal Adonai yizaf libbo".

Yetev rabbi yochanan veka matma. amar: mi ikka midde dichtivi bichtuve dela remizi beorayyta? amar leh: attu ha mi la remizi, vehachtiv: "vayyetze libbam vayyecherdu ish el achiv lemor ma zot asa elohim lanu".
Dal eneh vachaza beh, atya immeh appekteh, amara leh: ta mikkammeh, dela lebad lach kedaavad laavuch.

Amar rabbi yochanan: matar bishvil yachid, parnasa bishvil rabbim. matar bishvil yachid, dichtiv: "yiftach Adonai lecha et otzaro hattov latet metar artzecha". parnasa bishvil rabbim, dichtiv: "hinni mamtir lachem lechem".

Metivi, rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: shelosha parnasim tovim amdu leyisrael, ellu hen: moshe veaharon umiryam. veshalosh mattanot tovot nittenu al yadam, veellu hen: beer, veanan, uman. beer — bizchut miryam, ammud anan — bizchut aharon, man — bizchut moshe. meta miryam — nistallek habbeer, shenneemar: "vattamot sham miryam", uchetiv batreh: "velo haya mayim laeda", vechazra bizchut shenehen.

Met aharon — nistalleku anne kavod, shenneemar: "vayyishma hakkenaani melech arad", ma shemua shama? shama shemmet aharon venistalleku anne kavod, uchesavur nittena lo reshut lehillachem beyisrael. vehayeynu dichtiv: "vayyiru kol haeda ki gava aharon".
Amar rabbi avahu: al tikre "vayyiru", ella "vayyirau". kiddaresh resh lakish, deamar resh lakish: "ki" meshammesh bearba leshonot: i, dilma, ella, deha.

Chazru shenehem bizchut moshe, met moshe nistalleku kullan, shenneemar: "vaachchid et sheloshet haroim beyerach echad", vechi beyerach echad metu? vahalo miryam meta benisan, veaharon beav, umoshe baadar! ella, melammed shennitbattelu shalosh mattanot tovot shennittenu al yadan, venistalleku kullan beyerach echad.
Alma ashkechan parnasa bishvil yachid! shane moshe, kevan dilrabbim hu bae — kerabbim dame.

Rav huna bar manoach verav shemuel bar idi verav chiyyay miuostanya havo shechichi kammeh derava. ki nach nafsheh derava, ato lekammeh derav pappa, kol emat dahava amar lehu shemata vela hava mistabbera lehu, havo merammezi ahadade. chalash dateh.
b: Akreyu bechelmeh: "vaachchid et sheloshet haroim". limchar, ki havo mippatri minneh, amar lehu: lezlu rabbanan bishlama.

Rav shimi bar ashe hava shechiach kammeh derav pappa, hava makshe leh tuva. yoma chad chazyeh dinfal al appeh, shameh deamar: rachamana litztzelan mikkissufa deshimi. kabbel aleh shetikuta, vetu la akshi leh.

Veaf resh lakish savar matar bishvil yachid, deamar resh lakish: minnayin lammatar bishvil yachid, dichtiv: "shaalu meAdonai matar beet malkosh Adonai ose chazizim umetar geshem yitten lahem leish esev bassade".
Yachol lakkol — talmud lomar "leish". vetanya: i leish, yachol lechol sedotav — talmud lomar: "sade". i sade, yachol lechol hassade — talmud lomar: "esev".
Ki ha derav daniel bar kattina hava leh hahi ginneta. kol yoma hava azel vesayayr la. amar: ha meshra baaya mayya, veha meshra la baaya mayya. vaata mitra vekamashke kol hecha demibbee leh mayya.

May "Adonai ose chazizim"? amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: melammed shekkol tzaddik hakkadosh baruch hu ose lo chaziz bifne atzmo. may "chazizim"? amar rav yehuda: porchot. amar rabbi yochanan: siman lammatar — porchot. may porchot? amar rav pappa: eva kelisha tute eva semichta.
Amar rav yehuda: nehila mikkamme mitra — ate mitra. batar mitra — pasek mitra. mikkamme mitra — ate mitra. vesimanaych: maholta. devatar mitra — pasek mitra. vesimanaych: charya deizze.
Ulla ikkela levavel, chaza porchot, amar lehu: pannu mane, dehashta ate mitra. lesof la ate mitra. amar: ki hechi dimshakkeri bavlae, hachi meshakkeri mitrayyhu.
Ulla ikkela levavel, chaze mela tzanna detamre bezuza. amar: mela tzanna deduvesha bezuza, uvavlae la aski beorayyta? belelya tzaaruhu, amar: mela tzanna desakkine bezuza, uvavlae aski beorayyta!

Tanya, rabbi eliezer omer: kol haolam kullo mimmeme okyaynos hu shote, shenneemar: "veed yaale min haaretz vehishka et kol pene haadama". amar lo rabbi yehoshua: vahalo meme okyaynos meluchin hen! amar lo: mitmattekin beavim.

Rabbi yehoshua omer: kol haolam kullo mimmayim haelyonim hu shote, shenneemar: "limtar hashshamayim tishte mayim", ella ma ani mekayyem "veed yaale min haaretz"? melammed shehaananim mitgabberim veolim larakia, ufotchin pihen kenod, umekabbelin me matar, shenneemar: "yazokku matar leedo".

Umenukkavot hen kichvara, uvaot umechashsherot mayim al gabbe karka, shenneemar: "chashrat mayim ave shechakim". veen ben tippa letippa ella kimlo nima, lelammedcha sheggadol yom haggeshamim keyom shennivreu bo shamayim vaaretz.

Shenneemar: "ose gedolot veen cheker", uchetiv: "hannoten matar al pene aretz", uchetiv lehallan: "halo yadata im lo shamata elohe olam Adonai en cheker litvunato", uchetiv: "mechin harim bechocho vegomer".
Keman azla ha dichtiv: "mashke harim mealiyyotav", veamar rabbi yochanan: mealiyyotav shel hakkadosh baruch hu, keman — kerabbi yehoshua.

Verabbi eliezer, kevan desalki lehatam — "mashke mealiyyotav" kare lehu. dei la tema hachi, "avak veafar min hashshamayim" hechi mashkachat la? ella kevan demiddele lehatam — "min hashshamayim" kare leh. hachi name: desalki lehatam — "mealiyyotav" kare leh.
Keman azla ha deamar rabbi chanina: "kones kanned me hayyam noten beotzarot tehomot". mi garam laotzarot sheyyitmalleu bar — tehomot, kerabbi eliezer. verabbi yehoshua: hahu

a: Bivriyyayto shel olam.

Tanu rabbanan: eretz yisrael nivret techilla vechol haolam kullo nivra levassof, shenneemar: "ad lo asa eretz vechutzot". eretz yisrael mashke otah hakkadosh baruch hu beatzmo, vechol haolam kullo al yede shaliach, shenneemar: "hannoten matar al pene aretz vesholeach mayim al pene chutzot".

Eretz yisrael shota me geshamim, vechol haolam kullo mittamtzit, shenneemar: "hannoten matar al pene aretz vegomer". eretz yisrael shota techilla, vechol haolam kullo levassof, shenneemar: "hannoten matar al pene aretz vegomer" — mashal leadam shemmegabbel et haggevina, notel et haochel umanniach et happesolet.
Amar mar: mimmattekin hen beavim. menaleh? deamar rav yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yochanan, ketiv: "cheshchat mayim ave shechakim", uchetiv: "chashrat mayim ave shechakim".
Shekol kaf ushedi aresh ukeri beh "chachsharat".
Verabbi yehoshua, behane kerae may daresh behu? savar la ki ha dechi ata rav dimi amar, amri bemareva: nehur anane — zeerin mohi. chashuch anane — saggiyyin mohi.

Keman azla ha detanya: mayim haelyonim bemaamar hem teluyim, uferotehen me geshamim, shenneemar: "mipperi maasecha tisba haaretz", keman — kerabbi yehoshua. verabbi eliezer: hahu, bemaase yadav shel hakkadosh baruch hu hu dichtiv.
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol haolam kullo mittamtzit gan eden hu shote, shenneemar: "venahar yotze meeden vegomer", tana: mittamtzit bet kor shote tarkav.

Tanu rabbanan: eretz mitzrayim havya arba meot parsa al arba meot parsa, vehu echad mishshishshim bechush, vechush — echad mishshishshim baolam, veolam — echad mishshishshim baggan, vegan — echad mishshishshim leeden, veeden — echad mishshishshim legehinnam, nimtza kol haolam kullo kechissuy kedera legehinnam. veyesh omrim: gehinnam en lah shiur, veyesh omrim: eden en lah shiur.

Amar rabbi oshaya, may dichtiv: "shochant al mayim rabbim rabbat otzarot", mi garam levavel sheyyehu otzroteha meleot bar, heve omer: mippene sheshshochenet al mayim rabbim. amar rav: attira bavel dechatzda bela mitra. amar abbaye: nekitinan, tovani velo yovshani.
Mishna bishlosha bimrachshevan shoalin et haggeshamim. rabban gamliel omer: beshiva bo, chamishsha asar yom achar hechag. kede sheyyaggia acharon shebbeyisrael linhar perat.
Gemara amar rabbi elazar: halacha kerabban gamliel. tanya, chananya omer: uvaggola, ad shishshim battekufa. amar rav huna bar chiyyay amar shemuel: halacha kachananya.
Ini?! veha beo minneh mishshemuel: meemat madkerinan "veten tal umatar"? amar lehu: mikki meayyeyli tzive leve tavut rishba! dilma idde veidde chad shiura hu.
Ibbaya lehu: yom shishshim, kelifne shishshim o kilachar shishshim? ta shema, rav amar: yom shishshim kilachar shishshim, ushemuel amar: yom shishshim kelifne shishshim.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: vesimanach illae bau mayya, tattae la bau mayya. amar rav pappa, hilcheta: yom shishshim kilachar shishshim.

Mishna higgia shiva asar bemarcheshvan velo yardu geshamim — hitchilu hayyechidim mitannin shalosh taaniyyot. ochlin veshotin mishshechashecha, umuttarin bimlacha uvirchitza uvesicha uvinilat hassandal uvetashmish hammitta. higgia rosh chodesh kislev velo yardu geshamim — bet din gozrin shalosh taaniyyot al hatztzibbur. ochlin veshotin mishshechashecha, umuttarin bimlacha uvirchitza uvesicha uvinilat hassandal uvetashmish hammitta.
Gemara man "yechidim"? amar rav huna: rabbanan. vaamar rav huna: yechidim mitannin shalosh taaniyyot, sheni vachamishi vesheni.
May kamashma lan? tenena: en gozrin taanit al hatztzibbur battechilla bachamishi, shello lehafekia et hashshearim, ella shalosh taaniyyot harishonot sheni vachamishi vesheni!
Mahu detema: hane mille tzibbur, aval yachid la, kamashma lan. tanya name hachi: keshehitchilu hayyechidim lehitannot, mitannin sheni vachamishi vesheni, umafsikin berashe chodashim
b: Uveyamim tovim hakketuvin bimgillat taanit.

Tanu rabbanan: al yomar adam talmid ani, eni rauy lihyot yachid, ella: kol talmide chachamim yechidim. ezehu yachid veezehu talmid? yachid — kol sherauy lemannoto parnas al hatztzibbur, talmid — kol sheshshoalin oto davar halacha betalmudo veomer, vaafillu bemassechta dechalla.
Tanu rabbanan: lo kol harotze laasot atzmo yachid ose, talmid — ose, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer: ose, vezachur lattov, lefi sheen shevach hu lo, ella tzaar hu lo.

Tanya iddach: lo kol harotze laasot atzmo yachid ose, talmid — ose, divre rabbi shimon ben elazar. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: bamme devarim amurim: bedavar shel shevach, aval bedavar shel tzaar — ose, vezachur lattov, sheen shevach hu lo, ella tzaar hu lo.

Tanu rabbanan: mi shehaya mitanne al hatztzara veavra, al hachole venitrappe — hare ze mitanne umashlim. haholech mimmekom sheen mitannin limkom shemmitannin — hare ze mitanne immahen. mimmekom shemmitannin limkom sheen mitannin — hare ze mitanne umashlim.

Shachach veachal veshata — al yitrae bifne hatztzibbur, veal yanhig iddunin beatzmo, shenneemar: "vayyomer yaakov levanav lamma titrau", amar lahem yaakov levanav: al taru atzmechem kesheattem sevein, lo bifne esav velo bifne yishmael, kede shello yitkanneu bachem.
"Al tirgezu baddarech", amar rabbi elazar, amar lahem yosef leechav: al titasseku bidvar halacha, shemma teraggezu alechem hadderech.

Ini? vehaamar rabbi ilay bar berechya: shene talmide chachamim shemmehallechim badderech veen benehen divre tora — reuyin lissaref, shenneemar: "vayhi hemma holchim haloch vedabber vehinne rechev esh vesuse esh vayyafridu ben shenehem", tama deikka dibbur, ha lekka dibbur — reuyin lissaref!
La kashya: ha — lemigras, ha — leayyone.
Bematnita tana: al tafsiu pesia gassa, vehachenisu chamma lair. al tafsiu pesia gassa — deamar mar: pesia gassa notelet echad mechamesh meot mimmeor enav shel adam.
Vehachenisu chamma lair — kidrav yehuda amar rav. deamar rav yehuda amar rav: leolam yetze adam bechi tov" veyikkanes bechi tov", shenneemar: "habboker or vehaanashim shullechu".
Amar rav yehuda amar rabbi chiyyay: hamehallech badderech — al yochal yoter mishshene reavon. may tama? hacha targimu: mishshum mayayna. bemareva amri: mishshum mezone. may benayyhu? ikka benayyhu,

a: Deyatev bearba. i name, dekaazel meauona leauona.
Rav pappa — kol parsa ufarsa achel chada rifta. kasavar, mishshum mayayna.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: kol hammariv atzmo bishne reavon, — nitztzal mimmita meshunna, shenneemar: "baraav padcha mimmavet". "meraav" mibbee leh, ella hachi kaamar: bischar shemmariv atzmo bishne reavon — nitztzol mimmita meshunna.
Amar resh lakish: asur leadam leshammesh mittato bishne reavon, shenneemar: "uleyosef yullad shene vanim beterem tavo shenat haraav". tana: chasuche banim meshammeshin mittotehen bishne reavon.

Tanu rabbanan: bizman sheyyisrael sheruyin betzaar uferash echad mehen, bain shene malache hashsharet shemmelavvin lo laadam, umannichin lo yedehen al rosho, veomrim: peloni ze shepperash min hatztzibbur al yire benechamat tzibbur.

Tanya iddach: bizman shehatztzibbur sharuy betzaar, al yomar adam: elech leveti, veochal veeshte, veshalom alayich nafshi. veim ose ken — alav hakkatuv omer: "vehinne sason vesimcha harog bakar veshachot tzon achol basar veshatot yayin achol veshato ki machar namut", ma ketiv batreh — "venigla veoznay Adonai tzevaot im yechuppar heavon hazze lachem ad temutun".

Ad kan middat benonim. aval bemiddat reshaim, ma ketiv? "etayu ekcha yayin venisbea shechar vehaya chaze yom machar", ma ketiv batreh: "hatztzaddik avad veen ish sam al lev ki mippene haraa neesaf hatztzaddik".

Ella, yetzaer adam im hatztzibbur, shekken matzinu bemoshe rabbenu shetztzier atzmo im hatztzibbur, shenneemar: "vide moshe kevedim vayyikchu even vayyasimu tachtav vayyeshev aleha", vechi lo haya lo lemoshe kar echad o keset achat leshev aleha? ella kach amar moshe: hoil veyisrael sheruyin betzaar — af ani ehye immahem betzaar. vechol hametzaer atzmo im hatztzibbur — zoche veroe benechamat tzibbur.

Veshemma yomar adam: mi meid bi? avne veto shel adam vekorot beto shel adam meidim bo, shenneemar: "ki even mikkir tizak vechafis meetz yaanenna". deve rabbi shela amri: shene malache hashsharet hamelavvin lo laadam, hen meidin alav, shenneemar: "ki malachav yetzavve lach".
Rabbi chidka omer: nishmato shel adam hi meida alav, shenneemar: "mishshochevet chekecha shemor pitche ficha". veyesh omrim: evarav shel adam meidim bo, shenneemar: "attem eday neum Adonai".
"El emuna veen avel". "el emuna", keshem shennifrain min harshaim laolam habba afillu al avera kalla sheosin, kach nifrain min hatztzaddikim baolam hazze al avera kalla sheosin.
"Veen avel", keshem shemmeshallemin sachar latztzaddikim laolam habba afillu al mitzva kalla sheosin, kach meshallemin sachar larshaim baolam hazze afillu al mitzva kalla sheosin.

"Tzaddik veyashar hu", amru: bishat petirato shel adam levet olamo kol maasav nifratin lefanav, veomrim lo: kach vechach asita bemakom peloni beyom peloni, vehu omer: hen, veomrim lo: chatom! vechotem. shenneemar: "beyad kol adam yachtom". velo od, ella shemmatzdik alav et haddin, veomer lahem: yafe dantuni, lekayyem ma shenneemar "lemaan titzdak bedovrecha".

Amar shemuel: kol hayyoshev betaanit nikra chote. savar ki hay tanna, detanya: rabbi elazar hakkappar berabbi omer, ma talmud lomar: "vechipper alav measher chata al hannafesh", vechi beeze nefesh chata ze? ella shetztzier atzmo min hayyayin.
Vahalo devarim kal vechomer: uma ze, shello tzier atzmo ella min hayyayin — nikra chote, hametzaer atzmo mikkol davar vedavar — al achat kamma vechamma.

Rabbi elazar omer: nikra kadosh, shenneemar: "kadosh yihye gaddel pera sear rosho". uma ze, shello tzier atzmo ella middavar echad — nikra kadosh, hametzaer atzmo mikkol davar — al achat kamma vechamma.
Velishmuel, ha ikkeri kadosh! hahu, aggiddul pera kae. ulerabbi elazar, ha nikra chote! hahu desaev nafsheh.
Umi amar rabbi elazar hachi? vehaamar rabbi elazar: leolam yamod adam atzmo
b: Keillu kadosh sharuy betoch meav, shenneemar: "bekirbecha kadosh velo avo beir"! la kashya: ha — dematze letzaore nafsheh, ha — dela matze letzaore nafsheh.
Resh lakish amar: nikra chasid, shenneemar: "gomel nafsho ish chased veocher sheero vegomer". amar rav sheshet: hay bar be rav deyatev betaanita — lechol kalba lesheruteh.

Amar rav yirmeya bar abba: en taanit tzibbur bevavel ella tisha beav bilvad. amar rav yirmeya bar abba amar resh lakish: en talmid chacham rashshay leshev betaanit, mippene shemmemaet bimlechet shamayim.

Ochlin veshotin mishshechashecha kulei. amar rabbi zeera amar rav huna: yachid shekkibbel alav taanit, afillu achal veshata kol hallayla — lemachar hu mitpallel tefillat taanit. lan betaanito — eno mitpallel shel taanit.
Amar rav yosef: may kasavar rav huna? sevira leh: en mitannin leshaot, o dilma: mitannin leshaot — vehammitanne leshaot eno mitpallel tefillat taanit?
Amar leh abbaye: leolam kasavar rav huna mitannin leshaot, vehammitanne leshaot mitpallel tefillat taanit. veshane hacha, deikka shaot delelya dela kabbel aleh meikkara.

Mar ukeva ikkela leginzak, beo minneh: mitannin leshaot o en mitannin leshaot? la hava bideh. kankannin shel nochrim, asurin o muttarin? la hava bideh. bamme shimmesh moshe kol shivat yeme hammilluim? la hava bideh.

Azal usheel be midresha. amaru leh, hilcheta: mitannin leshaot, umitpallelin tefillat taanit, vehilcheta: kankannin shel nochrim, leachar shenem asar chodesh — muttarin. bamme shimmesh moshe kol shivat yeme hammilluim — bechaluk lavan. rav kahana matne: bechaluk lavan sheen lo immera.
Amar rav chisda:

a: Ha deamrat mitannin leshaot — vehu shello taam kelum ad haerev. amar leh abbaye: ha taanit meallayyta hi! la tzericha — deimmelach immeloche.
Veamar rav chisda: kol taanit shello shaka alav chamma — la shemeh taanit. metivi: anshe mishmar mitannin velo mashlimin! hatam, letzaore nafsheh bealma hu.

Ta shema, deamar rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok: ani mibbene vanav shel senaa ben binyamin, ufaam achat chal tisha beav lihyot beshabbat, udechinuhu leachar hashshabbat, vehitanninu bo velo hishlamnuhu — mippene sheyyom tov shellanu hu. hatam name, letzaore nafsheh bealma hu.
Ta shema, deamar rabbi yochanan: ehe betaanit ad sheavo leveti. hatam, leshammote nafsheh mibbe nesia hu daavad.
Amar shemuel: kol taanit shello kibbel alav mibbeod yom — lav shemeh taanit. vei yatev, may? amar rabba bar shela: dame lemappucha demalya zika.
Emat mekabbel leh? rav amar: bemincha, ushemuel amar: bitfillat hammincha. amar rav yosef: kevoteh dishmuel mistabbera, dichtiv bimgillat taanit: lahen, kol inish deyete alohi mikkadmat dena — yesar.
May lav — yesar atzmo bitzlo? la — yesar atzmo.
Peligi ba rabbi chiyyay verabbi shimon berabbi. chad amar: yesar, vechad amar: yeaser. man deamar yesar — kidamrinan. leman deamar yeaser — may hi?

Detanya bimgillat taanit: kol inish deyete alohi mikkadmat dena yeaser. ketzad? yachid shekkibbel alav sheni vachamishi vesheni shel kol hashshana kullah, veeru bam yamim tovim hakketuvin bimgillat taanit, im nidro kodem ligzeratenu — yevattel nidro et gezeratenu, veim gezeratenu kodemet lenidro — tevattel gezeratenu et nidro.

Tanu rabbanan: ad matay ochel veshote — ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar, divre rabbi. rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: ad kerot haggever. amar abbaye: lo shanu ella shello gamar seudato, aval gamar seudato — eno ochel.

Etiveh rava: gamar veamad — hare ze ochel! hatam keshello sillek. ikka deamri, amar rava: lo shanu ella keshello yashan, aval yashan — eno ochel. etiveh abbaye: yashan veamad — hare ze ochel! hatam bemitnamnem.
Hechi dame mitnamnem? amar rav ashe:
b: Nim vela nim, tir vela tir. dekaru leh veane, vela yada ahdore sevara, vechi madkeri leh middechar.

Amar rav kahana amar rav: yachid shekkibbel alav taanit — asur binilat hassandal. chayyshinan shemma taanit tzibbur kibbel alav. hechi lebad? amar rabba bar rav shela, lema hachi: lemachar ehe lefanecha betaanit yachid.
Amaru leh rabbanan lerav sheshet: ha ka chazenan rabbanan dimsayyeymi mesanayyhu veatu leve taanita! ikkefad vaamar lehu: dilma mechal name achul.

Abbaye verava (meayyeyli ki m)sayymi afanta. marimar umar zutera mechallefi deyammina lismala vedismala leyammina. rabbanan deve rav ashe nafki ki orchayyhu, savri ki ha deamar shemuel: en taanit tzibbur bevavel ella tisha beav bilvad.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: love adam taanito uforea. ki amrita kammeh dishmuel, amar li: vechi neder kabbel aleh, dela saggi dela meshallem? letzaore nafsheh kabbel aleh. i matze — metzaar nafsheh, i la matze — la metzaar nafsheh.
Ikka deamri, amar rav yehuda amar rav: love adam taanito uforea. ki amrita kammeh dishmuel, amar li: peshita! lo yehe ella neder. neder — mi la matze bae leshallome umezal limchar uleyoma acharina.

Rav yehoshua bereh derav idde ikkela leve rav assi. avadu leh igla tilta, amaru leh: litom mar midde. amar lehu: betaanita yatevna. amaru leh: velozef mar velifra, la savar mar leha deamar rav yehuda amar rav: love adam taanito uforea? amar lehu: taanit chalom hu.

Veamar rabba bar machseya amar rav chama bar gureya amar rav: yafa taanit lachalom keesh linoret. amar rav chisda: uvo bayyom. veamar rav yosef: vaafillu beshabbat. may takkanteh? littev taanita letaanita.

Mishna avru ellu velo naanu — bet din gozrin shalosh taaniyyot acherot al hatztzibbur. ochlin veshotin mibbeod yom, vaasurin bimlacha uvirchitza uvesicha uvinilat hassandal uvetashmish hammitta, venoalin et hammerchatzaot.

Avru ellu velo naanu, bet din gozrin alehen od sheva shehen shelosh esre taaniyyot al hatztzibbur. hare ellu yeterot al harishonot, shebbeellu matriin, venoalin et hachanuyot. bashsheni mattin im chashecha, uvachamishi muttarin mippene kevod hashshabbat.

Avru ellu velo naanu, memaatin bemassa umattan, bevinyan uvintia, beerusin uvenissuin, uvishelat shalom ben adam lachavero — kivne adam hannezufin lammakom. hayyechidim chozrin umitannin ad sheyyetze nisan. yatza nisan veyardu geshamim — siman kelala, shenneemar: "halo ketzir chittim hayyom vegomer".

Gemara bishlama kullehu, it behu taanug: rechitza vesicha vetashmish hammitta, aval melacha — tzaar hu! amar rav chisda amar rav yirmeya bar abba, amar kera: "kaddeshu tzom kiru atzara isfu zekenim", kaatzeret, ma atzeret asur baasiyyayt melacha — af taanit asur baasiyyayt melacha.

I, ma atzeret meureta — af taanit name meureta! amar rabbi zera: ledidi mipparsha li minneh derabbi yirmeya bar abba. amar kera: "isfu zekenim", dumeya daasifat zekenim, ma asifat zekenim bayyom — af tzom name bayyom. veema mittihara? amar rav shisha bereh derav idi: mesayyay leh lerav huna, deamar: mitztzafra kinnufeya.

Hechi avdi? amar abbaye: mitztzafra ad palga deyoma meayyeyninan bemille demata. mikkan veelach, riva deyoma karenan besifra veaftarta, mikkan veelach baenan rachame, shenneemar: "vayyakumu al omdam vayyikreu besefer torat Adonai elohehem reviit hayyom ureviit mitvaddim umishtachavim laAdonai elohehem".

a: Efoch ana! la salka datach, dichtiv: "veelay yeasfu kol chared bedivre elohe yisrael al maal haggola vegomer", uchetiv: "uveminchat haerev kamti mittaaniti vaefresa chappay el Adonai".

Amar rafram bar pappa amar rav chisda: kol shehu mishshum evel, kegon tisha beav veavel — asur ben bechammin ben betzonen, kol shehu mishshum taanug, kegon taanit tzibbur — bechammin asur, betzonen muttar.
Amar rav idi bar avin: af anan name tenena: venoalin et hammerchatzaot. amar leh abbaye: vei betzonen asur, sochrin et hanneharot mibbee leh lemitne?!
Amar rav shisha bereh derav idi: abba hachi kashya leh, mikkedi tenan: asur birchitza — noalin et hammerchatzaot lema li? ella lav, shema minna: bechammin asur, betzonen muttar.
Lema mesayyay leh: kol chayyayve tevilot tovlin kedarkan, ben betisha beav ben beyom hakkippurim. bemay? ilema bechammin, tevila bechammin mi ikka? sheuvin ninhu.
Ella lav, betzonen. vechayyayve tevilot — in, inish acharina — la. amar rav chana bar kattina: lo nitzrecha ella lechamme teverya.

I hachi ema sefa: amar rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim: keday hu bet elohenu leabbed alav tevila paam achat bashshana. vei amrat betzonen muttar — yirchatz betzonen! amar rav pappa: beatra dela shechiach tzonen.

Ta shema: kesheamru "asur bimlacha" — lo amru ella bayyom, aval ballayla — muttar. uchesheamru "asur binilat hassandal" — lo amru ella bair, aval badderech — muttar. ha ketzad? yotze ladderech — noel, nichnas lair — choletz. uchesheamru "asur birchitza" — lo amru ella kol gufo, aval panav yadav veraglav — muttar, vechen atta motze bamnudde uvaavel.
May lav — akkullehu, uvemay askinan? ilema bechammin: panav yadav veraglav mi sheru? vehaamar rav sheshet: avel asur lehoshit etzbao bechammin! ella lav, betzonen!
La, leolam bechammin. udeka kashya lach "vechen atta motze bamnudde uvaavel" — ashsheara kae.

Ta shema, deamar rabbi abba hakkohen mishshum rabbi yose hakkohen: maase umetu banav shel rabbi yose ben rabbi chanina, verachatz betzonen kol shiva! hatam keshettechafuhu avalav hava, detanya: techafuhu avalav ze achar ze, hichbid searo — mekel betaar, umechabbes kesuto bemayim.
Amar rav chisda: betaar — aval lo bemisparayim, bemayim — velo beneter velo bechol.
Amar rava: avel muttar lirchotz betzonen kol shiva, midde dehave abbisra vechamra. metivi:
b: En habbogeret rashshaa lenavvevl et atzmah bime evel aviha. ha naara — rashshaa.
May lav birchitza, uvemay? ilema bechammin, en habbogeret rashshaa?! vehaamar rav chisda: avel asur lehoshit etzbao bechammin! ella lav, betzonen. la, akkichul ufirkus.
Lema mesayyay leh, deamar rabbi abba hakkohen mishshum rabbi yose hakkohen: maase umetu banav shel rabbi yose bar chanina, verachatz betzonen kol shiva!

Amri: hatam beshettechafuhu avalav ze achar ze. detanya: techafuhu avalav ze achar ze, hichbid searo — mekel betaar, umechabbes kesuto bemayim. amar rav chisda: betaar — aval lo bemisparayim, bemayim — velo beneter velo bechol velo beahal.
Ikka deamri, amar rava: avel asur betzonen kol shiva. may shena mibbasar veyayin? hatam lefakkoche pachdeh hu deaved.

Lema mesayyay leh: en habbogeret rashshaa lenavvevl atzmah. ha naara — rashshaa! bemay, ilema bechammin: en habbogeret rashshaa?! vehaamar rav chisda: avel asur lehoshit etzbao bechammin! ella lav, betzonen. la, akkichul ufirkus.

Amar rav chisda: zot omeret, avel asur betichboset kol shiva. vehilcheta: avel asur lirchotz kol gufo ben bechammin uven betzonen kol shiva. aval panav yadav veraglav, bechammin — asur, betzonen — muttar. aval lasuch, afillu kol shehu asur. veim leabber et hazzuhama — muttar.
Tzelota detaanita hechi madkerinan? adbereh rav yehuda lerav yitzchak bereh, uderash: yachid shekkibbel alav taanit — mitpallel shel taanit, vehechan omrah — ben "goel" lerofe".
Matkef la rav yitzchak: vechi yachid kovea beracha leatzmo? ella amar rav yitzchak: beshomea tefilla". vechen amar rav sheshet: beshomea tefilla".

Metivi: en ben yachid letzibbur, ella shezze mitpallel shemone esre, veze mitpallel tesha esre. may "yachid" umay "tzibbur"? illema yachid — mammash, vetzibbur — sheliach tzibbur, hane tesha esre? esrin vearba havu!

Ella lav, hachi kaamar: en ben yachid dekibbel alav taanit yachid leyachid shekkibbel alav taanit tzibbur, ella shezze mitpallel shemone esre, veze mitpallel tesha esre. shema minna: yachid kovea beracha leatzmo!
La, leolam ema lach sheliach tzibbur, udeka kashya lach: sheliach tzibbur esrin vearba metzalle — beshalosh taaniyyot rishonot, delekka esrim vearba.
Vela? veha "en ben" katane: en ben shalosh rishonot leshalosh emtzaiyyot, ella shebbeellu muttarin baasiyyayt melacha, uveellu asurin baasiyyayt melacha. ha leesrim vearba — ze vaze shavin!
Tena veshayyayr. may shayyayr dehay shayyayr? vetu: veha "en ben" katane! ella, tanna beissure ka mayyre, bitfillot la mayyre. vei baet ema: beemtzaayayta name la metzalle esrim vearba.

Vela?! vehatanya: en ben shalosh sheniyyot lesheva acharonot, ella shebbeillu matriin venoalin et hachanuyot. ha lechol divrehen — ze vaze shavin! vechi tema hacha name tena veshayyayr — veha "en ben" katane!
Vetisbera "en ben" davka?

a: Veha shayyayr teva! i mishshum teva — lav shiyyura hu. mille detzina — katane, mille divfarhesya — la katane.

Amar rav ashe: matnitin name dayka, dekatane: ma ellu yeterot al harishonot, ella shebbeellu matriin venoalin et hachanuyot. aval bechol divrehen — ze vaze shavin. vechi tema hacha name tena veshayyayr, veha "ma ellu" katane.

Vetisbera "ma ellu" davvka hu? veha shayyayr la teva! i mishshum teva — lav shiyyura hu, mishshum deka chashev la beiddach pirka. hasheta deatet lehachi: esrim vearbaa name lav shiyyura hu, dekatane la beiddach pirka.

May have ala? amar rabbi shemuel bar sisratay, vechen amar rav chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: ben "goel" lerofe". verav ashe amar mishshemeh derabbi yannay bereh derabbi yishmael: beshomea tefilla". vehilcheta, beshomea tefilla".

Tane chada: ubbarot umenikot mitannot barishonot, veen mitannot baacharonot. vetanya iddach: mitannot baacharonot, veen mitannot barishonot. vetanya iddach: en mitannot, lo barishonot velo baacharonot.
Amar rav ashe: nekot emtzaayayta bidach, demittartzan kullehu.
Ma ellu yeterot al harishonot, ella shebbeellu matriin venoalin et hachanuyot. bemay matriin? rav yehuda amar: beshofarot, verav yehuda bereh derav shemuel bar shilat mishshemeh derav amar: baanenu".

Ka salka datan, man deamar baanenu" — la amar beshofarot, uman deamar beshofarot — la amar baanenu". vehatanya: en pochatin mishsheva taaniyyot al hatztzibbur, shebbahen shemone esre hateraot. vesiman laddavar: yericho. viricho shofarot hava, uteyuveta leman deamar baanenu"!
Ella: beshofarot, dechulle alma la peligi dekare la hateraa. ki peligi baanenu". mar savar: kare la hateraa, umar savar: la kare la hateraa.
Leman deamar baanenu" — kol shekken beshofarot. uleman deamar beshofarot — aval baanenu la!

Vehatanya: ushear kol mine pureanuyot hammitraggeshot, kegon: chikkuch, chagav, zevuv vetzira veyattushin, veshilluach nechashim veakrabbim — lo hayu matriin ella tzoakin. midditzaka bappe, hateraa beshofarot!
Tannae hi, ditnan: al ellu matriin beshabbat, al ir shehikkifuha gayis o nahar, veal sefina hametorefet bayyam. rabbi yose omer: leezra, aval lo litzaka.
Bemay? ilema beshofarot — shofarot beshabbat mi shere? ella lav, baanenu", vekare la hateraa, shema minna.
Bishne derabbi yehuda nesia hava tzaara,
b: Gezar telat asre taaniyyot vela iani. sevar lemigzar tefe. amar leh rabbi amme: hare amru en matrichin et hatztzibbur yoter midday.

Amar rabbi abba bereh derabbi chiyyay bar abba: rabbi amme daavad — legarmeh hu daavad. ella hachi amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella ligshamim, aval lishar mine fureanuyot — mitannin veholchin ad sheyyeanu min hashshamayim. tanya name hachi: kesheamru shalosh uchesheamru sheva — lo amru ella ligshamim, aval lishar mine fureanuyot — mitannin veholchin ad sheyyeanu.

Lema tehve teyuveteh derabbi amme! amar lach rabbi amme: tannae hi, detanya: en gozrin yoter mishshelosh esre taaniyyot al hatztzibbur, lefi sheen matrichin et hatztzibbur yoter midday, divre rabbi. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: lo min hashshem hu ze, ella mippene sheyyatza zemannah shel revia.

Shelachu leh bene ninve lerabbi: kegon anan, daafillu bitkufat tammuz baenan mitra, hechi naaved? kichidim damenan o kerabbim damenan? kichidim damenan uveshomea tefilla", o kerabbim damenan uvevirkat hashshanim? shelach lehu: kichidim dametu uveshomea tefilla".

Metivi, amar rabbi yehuda: ematay — bizman shehashshanim ketiknan veyisrael sheruyin al admatan. aval bizman hazze — hakkol lefi hashshanim, hakkol lefi hammekomot, hakkol lefi hazzeman! amar leh: matnita ramet aleh derabbi?! rabbi tanna hu ufaleg.
May have ala? rav nachman amar: bevirkat hashshanim. rav sheshet amar: beshomea tefilla". vehilcheta: beshomea tefilla".

Bashsheni mattin im chashecha uvachamishi kol hayyom mippene kevod hashshabbat. ibbaya lehu, hechi katane: bashsheni mattin im chashecha, uvachamishi kol hayyom — mippene kevod hashshabbat, o dilma: bashsheni mattin, uvachamishi potchin kol hayyom kullo?

Ta shema, detanya: bashsheni mattin ad haerev, uvachamishi potchin kol hayyom kullo mippene kevod hashshabbat. hayu lo shene fetachim — poteach echad venoel echad. haya lo itzteva keneged pitcho — poteach kedarko veeno choshesh.

Avru ellu velo naanu — memaatin bemassa umattan, bevinyan uvintia. tana: bevinyan — binyan shel simcha. netia — netia shel simcha. e zehu binyan shel simcha — ze habbone bet chatnut livno. i zo hi netia shel simcha — ze hannotea abbevoranke shel melachim.

Uvishelat shalom. tanu rabbanan: chaverim, en sheelat shalom benehen. amme haaretz sheshshoalin — machzirin lahem besafa rafa, uvechoved rosh. vehen mitattefin veyoshvin kaavelim vechimnuddin, kivne adam hannezufin lammakom, ad sheyyerachamu alehem min hashshamayim.
Amar rabbi elazar: en adam chashuv rashshay lippol al panav, ella im ken naane kihoshua bin nun, shenneemar: "vayyomer Adonai el yehoshua kum lach lamma ze atta nofel al panecha".

Veamar rabbi elazar: en adam chashuv rashshay lachagor sak ella im ken naane kihoram ben achav, shenneemar: "vayhi chishmoa hammelech et divre haishsha vayyikra et begadav vehu over al hachoma vayyar haam vehinne hassak al besaro vegomer".

Veamar rabbi elazar: lo hakkol bikria velo hakkol binfila. moshe veaharon — binfila, yehoshua vechalev — bikria. moshe veaharon binfila, dichtiv: "vayyippol moshe veaharon al penehem". yehoshua vechalev bikria, dichtiv: "vihoshua bin nun vechalev ben yefunne karu bigdehem".
Matkef la rabbi zera, veittema rabbi shemuel bar nachmani: i hava ketiv "yehoshua" — kidkaamrat, hasheta dichtiv: "vihoshua", ha veha aved.
Veamar rabbi elazar: lo hakkol bekima velo hakkol behishtachavaya. melachim — bekima, vesarim — behishtachavaya. melachim bekima, dichtiv: "ko amar Adonai goel yisrael kedosho

a: Livzo nefesh limtaev goy leeved moshlim melachim yiru vakamu". vesarim behishtachavaya, dichtiv: "sarim veyishtachavu". matkef la rabbi zera, veittema rabbi shemuel bar nachmani: i hava ketiv "vesarim yishtachavu" — kidkaamrat, hasheta dichtiv "sarim veyishtachavu" — ha veha avud.

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak, af ani omer: lo hakkol leora, velo hakkol lesimcha. tzaddikim — leora, visharim — lesimcha. tzaddikim leora, dichtiv: "or zarua latztzaddik". velisharim simcha, dichtiv: "uleyishre lev simcha".
Hadaran alach meematay
Seder taaniyyot ketzad? motziin et hatteva, lirchovah shel ir, venotnin efer mikle al gabbe hatteva, uverosh hannasi, uverosh av bet din, vechol echad veechad noten berosho.

Hazzaken shebbahen omer lifnehen divre chibbushin: achenu! lo neemar beanshe ninve "vayyar elohim et sakkam veet taanitam", ella: "vayyar haelohim et maasehem ki shavu middarkam haraa", uvakkabbala hu omer: "vekiru levavchem veal bigdechem".
Amdu bitfilla — moridin lifne hatteva zaken veragil veyesh lo banim, uveto rekam, kede sheyyehe libbo shalem bitfilla.

Veomer lifnehen esrim vearba berachot: shemone esre shebbechol yom, umosif alehen od shesh, veellu hen: zichronot veshofarot, "el Adonai batztzarata li karati vayyaaneni", "essa enay el heharim vegomer", "mimmaamakkim keraticha Adonai", "tefilla leani chi yaatof".
Rabbi yehuda omer: lo haya tzarich lomar zichronot veshofarot, ella omer tachtehen "raav ki yihye vaaretz dever ki yihye", "asher haya devar Adonai el yirmeyahu al divre habbatztzarot".

Veomer chotmehen. al harishona hu omer: "mi sheana et avraham behar hammoriyya hu yaane etchem veyishma bekol tzaakatchem hayyom hazze. baruch atta Adonai goel yisrael". al hashsheniyya hu omer: "mi sheana et avotenu al yam suf hu yaane etchem veyishma kol tzaakatchem hayyom hazze, baruch atta Adonai zocher hannishkachot".

Al hashshelishit hu omer: "mi sheana et yehoshua baggilgal hu yaane etchem veyishma bekol tzaakatchem hayyom hazze, baruch atta Adonai shomea terua". al harviit hu omer: "mi sheana et shemuel bammitzpa hu yaane etchem veyishma bekol tzaakatchem hayyom hazze, baruch atta Adonai shomea tzeaka". al hachamishit hu omer: "mi sheana et eliyyahu behar hakkarmel hu yaane etchem veyishma bekol tzaakatchem hayyom hazze, baruch atta Adonai shomea tefilla".

Al hashshishshit hu omer: "mi sheana et yona mimmee haddaga, hu yaane etchem veyishma bekol tzaakatchem hayyom hazze, baruch atta Adonai haone beet tzara". al hashsheviit hu omer: "mi sheana et david veet shelomo beno birushalayim, hu yaane etchem veyishma bekol tzaakatchem hayyom hazze, baruch atta Adonai hamerachem al haaretz".
Maase
b: Bime rabbi chalafta verabbi chananya ben teradyon sheavar echad lifne hatteva vegamar et habberacha kullah, velo anu acharav amen. tiku hakkohanim tiku! mi sheana et avraham avinu behar hammoriyya, hu yaane etchem veyishma bekol tzaakatchem hayyom hazze. hariu bene aharon hariu! mi sheana et avotenu al yam suf, hu yaane etchem veyishma bekol tzaakatchem hayyom hazze.
Ucheshebba davar etzel chachamim, amru: lo hayinu nohagin ken, ella beshaar mizrach uvehar habbayit.

Shalosh taaniyyot harishonot — anshe mishmar mitannin velo mashlimin, veanshe bet av lo hayu mitannin kelal. shalosh sheniyyot — anshe mishmar mitannin umashlimin, veanshe bet av mitannin velo mashlimin. sheva acharonot — ellu vaellu mitannin umashlimin, divre rabbi yehoshua.

Vachachamim omrim: shalosh taaniyyot harishonot — ellu vaellu lo hayu mitannin kelal. shalosh sheniyyot — anshe mishmar mitannin velo mashlimin, veanshe bet av lo hayu mitannin kelal, sheva acharonot — anshe mishmar mitannin umashlimin, veanshe bet av mitannin velo mashlimin.

Anshe mishmar — muttarin lishtot yayin ballelot, aval lo bayyamim, veanshe bet av — lo bayyom velo ballayla. anshe mishmar veanshe maamad — asurin millesapper umillechabbes. uvachamishi muttarin, mippene kevod hashshabbat.
Kol hakkatuv bimgillat taanit "dela lemispad" — lefanav asur, leacharav — muttar. rabbi yose omer: lefanav uleacharav asur.
"Dela lehitannaa" — lefanav uleacharav muttar. rabbi yose omer: lefanav asur, leacharav muttar.

En gozrin taanit al hatztzibbur battechilla bachamishi, shello lehafekia hashshearim. ella shalosh taaniyyot harishonot: sheni vachamishi vesheni, veshalosh sheniyyot: chamishi sheni vachamishi. rabbi yose omer: keshem sheen harishonot bachamishi, kach lo sheniyyot velo acharonot.

En gozrin taanit al hatztzibbur berashe chodashim, bachanukka, uvefurim. veim hitchilu — en mafsikin, divre rabban gamliel. amar rabbi meir: af al pi sheamar rabban gamliel en mafsikin, mode haya sheen mashlimin. vechen tisha beav shechal lihyot beerev shabbat.

Gemara seder taaniyyot ketzad? motziin et hatteva kulei. vaafillu bekammayyta? ureminhu: shalosh taaniyyot rishonot usheniyyot nichnasim levet hakkeneset, umitpallelin kederech shemmitpallelin kol hashshana kullah

Uvesheva acharonot motziin et hatteva lirchovah shel ir, venotnin efer al gabbe hatteva, uverosh hannasi, uverosh av bet din, vechol echad veechad notel venoten berosho. rabbi natan omer: efer mikle hen meviin! amar rav pappa: ki tenan name matnitin — ashsheva acharonot tenan.
Uverosh hannasi, vahadar tane kol echad veechad noten berosho. ini?! vehatanya: rabbi omer: bigdulla matchilin min haggadol, uviklala matchilin min hakkatan.

Bigdulla matchilin min haggadol, shenneemar: "vayyomer moshe el aharon uleelazar uleitamar". uviklala matchilin min hakkatan — shebbattechilla nitkallel nachash, veachar kach nitkallela chavva, veachar kach nitkallel adam!
Ha chashivuta ledidhu, deamri lehu: attun chashivitu lemive alan rachame akkulle alma.

Kol echad veechad noten berosho. nasi veav bet din name nishkelu inhu venaynnechu bereshayyhu, may shena deshakel inish acharina umannach lehu? amar rabbi abba demin kesari: eno dome mitbayyesh meatzmo

a: Lemitbayyesh meacherim. vehecha mannach lehu? amar rabbi yitzchak: bimkom tefillin. shenneemar: "lasum laavele tziyyon latet lahem peer tachat efer".
Rechov, teva, vesakkim, efer, efer, kevura, umoriyya siman. lamma yotzin larchov? rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar: lomar — zaaknu betzina velo naanenu, nevazze atzmenu befarhesya.
Resh lakish amar: galinu, galutenu mechapperet alenu. may benayyhu? ikka benayyhu, degalu mibbe chenishta leve chenishta.
Velamma motziin et hatteva lirchovah shel ir? amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi, lomar: keli tzanua haya lanu, venitbazza baavonenu.

Velamma mitkassin besakkim? amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba: lomar — hare anu chashuvin kivhema. velamma notnin efer mikle al gabbe teva? amar rabbi yehuda ben pazzi: kelomar — "immo anochi betzara". resh lakish amar: "bechol tzaratam lo tzar". amar rabbi zera: meresh ki hava chazena lehu lerabbanan deyahavi efer mikle al gabbe teva — mizdaza li kulleh gufay.

Velamma notnin efer berosh kol echad veechad? peligi ba rabbi levi bar chama verabbi chanina. chad amar: hare anu chashuvin lefanecha keefer, vechad amar: kede sheyyizkor lanu efro shel yitzchak. may benayyhu? ikka benayyhu afar setam.

Lamma yotzin levet hakkevarot? peligi ba rabbi levi bar chama verabbi chanina. chad amar: hare anu chashuvin lefanecha kemetim, vechad amar: kede sheyyevakkeshu alenu metim rachamim. may benayyhu? ikka benayyhu kivre nochrim.
May har hammoriyya? peligi ba rabbi levi bar chama verabbi chanina. chad amar: har sheyyatza mimmennu horaa leyisrael, vechad amar: har sheyyatza mimmennu mora leummot haolam.

Hazzaken shebbahen omer lifnehen divre chibbushin. tanu rabbanan: im yesh zaken — omer zaken. veim lav — omer chacham, veim lav — omer adam shel tzura. attu zaken dekaamri, af al gav delav chacham hu? amar abbaye, hachi kaamar: im yesh zaken vehu chacham — omer zaken vehu chacham, veim lav — omer chacham, veim lav — omer adam shel tzura.

Achenu, lo sak vetaanit gormim, ella teshuva umaasim tovim gormim. shekken matzinu beanshe ninve, shello neemar bahem "vayyar haelohim et sakkam veet taanitam", ella: "vayyar haelohim et maasehem ki shavu middarkam haraa".
"Veyitkassu sakkim haadam vehabbehema", may havo avdi? asru habbehemot lechud, veet havvevladot lechud. amru lefanav: ribbono shel olam! im en atta merachem alenu — en anu merachamim al ellu.
"Veyikreu el elohim bechozka", may amur? amru lefanav: ribbono shel olam! aluv vesheeno aluv, tzaddik verasha — mi nidche mippene mi?

"Veyashuvu ish middarko haraa umin hechamas asher bechappehem", may "umin hechamas asher bechappehem"? amar shemuel: afillu gazal marish uvenao bevira — mekakea kol habbira kullah umachzir marish livalav.

Amar rav adda bar ahava: adam sheyyesh beyado avera, umitvadde veeno chozer bah, lema hu dome? leadam shettofes sheretz beyado, sheafillu tovel bechol memot shebbaolam — lo alta lo tevila. zerako miyyado, kevan shettaval bearbaim sea — miyyad alta lo tevila,
Shenneemar: "umode veozev yerucham", veomer: "nissa levavenu el kappayim el el bashshamayim".

Amdu bitfilla, moridin lifne hatteva zaken kulei. tanu rabbanan: amdu bitfilla, af al pi sheyyesh sham zaken vechacham — en moridin lifne hatteva ella adam haragil. rabbi yehuda omer: metuppal veen lo, veyesh lo yegia bassade, uveto rekam,

Ufirko nae, ushefal berech, umerutztze laam, veyesh lo neima, vekolo arev, uvaki likrot battora uvanneviim uvakketuvim, velishnot bammidrash bahalachot uvaaggadot, uvaki bechol habberachot kullan. vihavu beh rabbanan enayyhu berav yitzchak bar amme.
b: Hayeynu "metuppal veen lo", hayeynu "beto rekam"? amar rav chisda: zehu shebbeto rekam min haavera. "ufirko nae", amar abbaye: ze shello yatza alav shem ra beyalduto.

"Hayta li nachalati kearye vayyaar natna alay bekolah al ken senetiha", may "natna alay bekolah"? amar mar zutera bar toviyya amar rav, veamri la amar rabbi chama amar rabbi elazar: ze sheliach tzibbur sheeno hagun hayyored lifne hatteva.
