Veomer lifnehem esrim vearba berachot, shemone esre shebbechol yom umosif alehen od shesh. hane shesh, sheva havvyayn! keditnan: al hashsheviit hu omer "baruch merachem al haaretz"! amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: may "sheviit" — sheviit laarukka.

Kidtanya: begoel yisrael" maarich, uvechotamah hu omer: "mi sheana et avraham behar hammoriyya, hu yaane etchem veyishma bekol tzaakatchem hayyom hazze. baruch goel yisrael", vehen onin acharav "amen", vechazzan hakkeneset omer lahem: "tiku bene aharon tiku".

Vechozer veomer: "mi sheana et avotenu al yam suf, hu yaane etchem veyishma bekol tzaakatchem hayyom hazze, baruch zocher hannishkachot", vehen onin acharav "amen", vechazzan hakkeneset omer lahem: "hariu bene aharon hariu". vechen bechol beracha uveracha, beachat omer: "tiku", uveachat omer: "hariu".
Bamme devarim amurim — bigvulin, aval bammikdash eno ken, lefi sheen onin "amen" bammikdash. uminnayin sheen onin "amen" bammikdash —

Shenneemar: "kumu barchu et Adonai elohechem min haolam ad haolam vivarchu shem kevodecha umeromam al kol beracha utehilla". yachol al kol berachot kullan lo tehe ella tehilla achat — talmud lomar: "umeromam al kol beracha utehilla" — al kol beracha ten lo tehilla.

Veella bammikdash mahu omer? "baruch Adonai elohe yisrael min haolam vead haolam. baruch goel yisrael". vehen onin acharav: "baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed". vechazzan hakkeneset omer lahem: "tiku hakkohanim bene aharon tiku",

Vechozer veomer: "mi sheana et avraham behar hammoriyya, hu yaane etchem veyishma bekol tzaakatchem hayyom hazze. baruch Adonai elohe yisrael zocher hannishkachot", vehem onim acharav: "baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed", vechazzan hakkeneset omer lahem: "hariu, hakkohanim bene aharon, hariu vechulei", vechen bechol beracha uveracha, beachat omer "tiku" uveachat omer "hariu", ad sheggomer et kullan.
Vechach hinhig rabbi chalafta betzippori, verabbi chananya ben teradyon besichni, ucheshebba davar lifne chachamim, amru: lo hayu nohagin ken ella beshaare mizrach uvehar habbayit.

Veit deamri, kidtanya: omer lifnehen esrim vearba berachot, shemone esre shebbechol yom, umosif alehen od shesh. veotan shesh hechan omran? ben "goel" lerofe chole", umaarich baggeulla, vehen onin acharav "amen" al kol beracha uveracha. vechach hayu nohagin bigvulin.

Aval bammikdash, hayu omrim: "baruch Adonai elohe yisrael min haolam vaed haolam. baruch goel yisrael." velo hayu onin acharav "amen". vechol kach lamma? lefi sheen onin "amen" bammikdash, uminnayin sheen onin "amen" bammikdash, shenneemar: "kumu barchu et Adonai elohechem min haolam ad haolam vivarchu shem kevodecha umeromam al kol beracha utehilla" — al kol beracha uveracha ten lo tehilla.

Tanu rabbanan: al harishonot hu omer "baruch Adonai elohe yisrael min haolam vaed haolam. baruch goel yisrael". vehen onin acharav: "baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed". vechazzan hakkeneset omer: "tiku kohanim tiku". vechozer veomer: "mi sheana et avraham behar hammoriyya, hu yaane etchem veyishma bekol tzaakatchem hayyom hazze", vehen tokin umeriin vetokin, veal hashsheniyya hu omer: "baruch Adonai elohe yisrael min haolam vaed haolam. baruch zocher hannishkachot". vehen onin acharav: "baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed",

Vechazzan hakkeneset omer: "hariu bene aharon hariu". veomer: "mi sheana et avotenu al yam suf, hu yaane etchem veyishma bekol tzaakatchem hayyom hazze", vehem meriin vetokin umeriin, vechen bechol beracha uveracha. beachat omer "tiku", uveachat omer "hariu", ad sheyyigmor et habberachot kullan. vechach hinhig rabbi chalafta betzippori verabbi chananya ben teradyon besichni. ucheshebba davar etzel chachamim, amru: lo hayu nohagin ken ella beshaare mizrach uvehar habbayit.
Rabbi yehuda omer: lo haya tzarich lomar zichronot kulei. amar rabbi adda demin yafo: may tama derabbi yehuda — lefi sheen omrim zichronot veshofarot

a: Ella berosh hashshana, uvayyovlot, uvishat milchama.
Al harishona hu omer: mi sheana et avraham kulei. tana: yesh machlifin tzeaka leeliyyahu, utefilla lishmuel. bishlama gabbe shemuel — ketiv beh tefilla uchetiv beh tzeaka.
Ella gabbe eliyyahu — tefilla ketiv, tzeaka la ketiv! "aneni Adonai aneni" leshon tzeaka hi.

Al hashshishshit hu omer: mi sheana et yona kulei. al hashsheviit hu omer: mi sheana et david kulei. mikkede yona batar david ushelomo hava, may tama makdem leh beresha? mishshum devae lemichtam "merachem al haaretz". tana, mishshum somchos amru: "baruch mashpil haramim".

Shalosh taaniyyot harishonot anshe mishmar mitannin velo mashlimin kulei. tanu rabbanan: mippene ma amru anshe mishmar muttarin lishtot yayin ballelot aval lo bayyamim — shemma tichbad haavoda al anshe bet av, veyavou visayyeyu lahem.
Mippene ma amru anshe bet av lo bayyom velo ballayla — mippene shehen asukin tamid baavoda.

Mikkan amru: kol kohen shemmakkir mishmarto umishmeret bet av shello, veyodea shebbatte avotav kevuin sham — asur lishtot yayin kol oto hayyom. bemakkir mishmarto veen makkir mishmeret bet av shello, veyodea shebbatte avotav kevuin sham — asur lishtot yayin kol otah shabbat.
Eno makkir mishmarto umishmeret bet av shello, veyodea shebbatte avotav kevuin sham — asur lishtot yayin kol hashshana.
Rabbi omer, omer ani: asur lishtot yayin leolam, aval ma eese shettakkanato kalkalato. amar abbaye: keman shatu haiddana kahane chamra — kerabbi.

Anshe mishmar veanshe maamad asurim lesapper ulechabbes, uvachamishi muttarin mippene kevod hashshabbat. may tama? amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: kede shello yikkansu lemishmartam keshehen menuuolin.

Tanu rabbanan: melech mistapper bechol yom, kohen gadol — meerev shabbat leerev shabbat, kohen hedyot — achat lishloshim yom. melech mistapper bechol yom — may tama? amar rabbi abba bar zavda, amar kera: "melech beyofyo techezena enecha". kohen gadol meerev shabbat leerev shabbat — may tama? amar rav shemuel bar yitzchak: hoil umishmarot mitchaddeshot.

Kohen hedyot achat lishloshim yom — menalan? atya "pera" "pera" minnazir, ketiv hacha: "verosham lo yegallechu ufera lo yeshallechu", uchetiv hatam: "kadosh yihye gaddel pera sear rosho", ma lehallan sheloshim — af kan sheloshim.

Venazir gufeh menalan? amar rav matna: setam nezirut sheloshim yom. menalan? amar kera: "yihye" — begimatriyya telatin have. amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: vedilma hachi kaamar rachamana: la lirabbo kelal! amar leh: i hava ketiv "lo yeshallechu pera" — kidkaamrat, hasheta dichtiv: "ufera lo yeshallechu" — pera leheve, shalloche hu dela lishallechu.
I hachi, afillu haiddana name! duvmya dishtuye yayin. ma shetuye yayin — bizman bia hu deasur, shello bizman bia — shere, af hacha name.
Vehatanya, rabbi omer: omer ani kohanim asurim lishtot yayin leolam, aval ma eese shettakkanato kalkalato. veamar abbaye: keman shatu haiddana kahane chamra —
b: Kerabbi, mikkelal derabbanan asri! may tama: mehera yibbane bet hammikdash, uvaenan kohen harauy laavoda velekka, hacha efshar dimsappar veayel.

I hachi, shetuy yayin name — efshar degane pureta veayel, kidrame bar abba. deamar rame bar abba: derech mil, veshena kol shehu — mefigin et hayyayin! lav mi ittemar ala, amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: lo shanu ella besheshshata shiur reviit, aval shata yoter merviit — kol shekken shedderech matridato veshena meshakkarto.
Rav ashe amar: shetuye yayin, demachali avoda — gezaru behu rabbanan. perue rosh, dela machali avoda — la gezaru behu rabbanan.
Metivi, veellu shehen bemita: shetuye yayin, uferue rosh. bishlama shetuye yayin — behedya ketiv behu: "yayin veshechar al tesht", ella perue rosh menalan?

Dichtiv: "verosham lo yegallechu ufera lo yeshallechu", uchetiv batreh: "veyayin lo yishtu kol kohen bevoam el hechatzer happenimit", veittakkush perue rosh lishtuye yayin: ma shetuye yayin bemita — af perue rosh bemita.
Uminna: i ma shetuye yayin demachali avoda — af perue rosh demachali avoda! la: ki ittakkush — lemita hu deittakkush, aval leachole avoda — la ittakkush.

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: ha, mikkamme daata yechezkel, man amra? amar leh: uletamaych, ha deamar rav chisda: davar ze mittorat moshe lo lamadnu, umiddivre kabbala lamadnu: "kol ben nechar erel lev veerel basar lo yavo el mikdashi" — ha, mikkamme daata yechezkel, man amra?
Ella gemara gemiri[10] la, vaata yechezkel veasmecha akkera. hacha name: gemara gemiri[10] la, vaata yechezkel veasmecha akkera, ki gemiri halacha — lemita, leachole avoda — la gemiri.

Kol hakkatuv bimgillat taanit "dela lemispad" — lefanav asur, leacharav muttar. tanu rabbanan: illen yomayya dela lehitannaa behon, umiktzathon dela lemispad behon: meresh yarcha denisan vead temanya beh ittokam temida, dela lemispad behon. mittemanya beh ad sof moada ittotav chagga deshavuayya, dela lemispad behon.

Amar mar: meresh yarcha denisan ad temanya beh ittokam temida, dela lemispad. lema li meresh yarcha? lema mittere benisan, verosh chodesh gufeh yom tov hu veasur! amar rav: lo nitzrecha ella leesor yom shellefanav.
Veshellefanav name, tippok leh dehave leh yom shellifne rosh chodesh! rosh chodesh deorayyta hu, udeorayyta la bae chizzuk.

Detanya: hayyamim haelle hakketuvin bimgillat taanit — lifnehem uleacharehem asurin, shabbatot veyamim tovim, hen — asurin, lifnehen uleacharehen — muttarin. uma hefresh ben ze laze? hallalu — divre tora, vedivre tora en tzerichin chizzuk, hallalu — divre sofrim, vedivre sofrim tzerichin chizzuk.
Amar mar: mittemanya beh ad sof moada ittotav chagga deshavuayya, dela lemispad. lema li ad sof moed, lema ad hammoed, umoed gufeh yom tov hu veasur! amar rav pappa: kidamar rav — lo nitzrecha

a: Ella leesor yom shellefanav, hacha name — la nitzrecha ella leesor yom shelleacharav. keman, kerabbi yose deamar: ben lefanav uven leacharav asur. i hachi beesrim vetisha name — may irya dehave yoma demikkamme yoma demittokam temida? tippok leh dehave leh yoma devatar esrin utemanya beh!

Detanya: beesrim utemanya beh, atat besorta tavta lihudae dela yeidon min orayyta. sheppaam achat gazra malchut harshaa shemad al yisrael shello yaasku battora, veshello yamulu et benehem, vesheyyechallelu shabbatot. ma asa yehuda ben shammua vachaverav? halchu venatlu etza mimmatronita achat shekkol gedole romi metzuyin etzlah.

Amra lahem: imdu vehafeginu ballayla. halchu vehifginu ballayla, amru: e shamayim! lo achim anachnu, lo bene av echad anachnu, lo bene em achat anachnu? ma nishtannenu mikkol umma velashon sheattem gozrin alenu gezerot raot! uvittelum, veoto yom asauhu yom tov.
Amar abbaye: lo nitzrecha ella lechodesh meubbar.
Rav ashe amar: afillu tema lechodesh chaser, kol shelleacharav — betaanit asur, behesped muttar. veze, hoil umutal ben shene yamim tovim — asauhu keyom tov atzmo, vaafillu behesped name asur.
Amar mar: mittemanya beh vead sof moada ittotav chagga deshavuayya, dela lemispad. lema li lememar mittemanya beh? lema mittisha beh, utemanya gufeh asur, dehave leh yoma deittokam beh temida!
Kevan deillu mikkela leh milleta uvattelinneh leshiva — temanya gufeh asur, dehave leh yoma kamma deittotav beh chagga deshavuayya.
Hasheta deatet lehachi, esrim vetisha name: kevan deillu mikkela milleta uvattelinneh leesrim utemanya — esrin vetisha gufeh asur, dehave leh yoma demikkamme yoma deittokam temida.
Ittemar, rav chiyyay bar assi amar rav: halacha kerabbi yose, ushemuel amar: halacha kerabbi meir.

Umi amar shemuel hachi? vehatanya, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: uma talmud lomar "behon" "behon" shete feamim — lomar lach shehen asurin, lifnehen uleacharehen muttarin. veamar shemuel: halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel.
Meikkara savar: kevan delekka tanna demekel kerabbi meir, amar halacha kerabbi meir. kevan deshameh lerabban shimon demekel tefe, amar: halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel.
Vechen amar bali amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kerabbi yose. amar leh rabbi chiyyay levali: asbera lach, ki amar rabbi yochanan halacha kerabbi yose — addela lehitannaa.
Umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi? vehaamar rabbi yochanan: halacha kistam mishna. utenan: af al pi sheamru makdimin velo meacharin,
b: Muttarin behesped vetaanit. emat? illema bene chamesar veka karu leh bearbesar, umi shere?
Vehachtiv bimgillat taanit: yom arbaa asar bo veyom chamishsha asar bo, yome purayya innun dela lemispad behon. veamar rava: lo nitzrecha, ella leesor et shel ze baze veet shel ze baze.
Veella, bene arbesar veka kare leh bitlesar — yom nikanor hu! veella, bene arbesar veka kare leh bitresar — yom tureyaynos hu!
Ella lav, deka karu leh bachadesar, vekatane muttar behesped uvetaanit!

La, bene arbaa asar, veka karu leh bitresar. udekaamrat yom turyaynos hu — yom turyaynos gufeh battole battelu, hoil venehergu bo shemaya vaachiyya echav. ki ha derav nachman gezar taanita bitresar, amaru leh rabbanan: yom tureyaynos hu! amar lehu: yom tureyaynos gufeh battole battelu, hoil venehergu bo shemaya vaachiyya achiv.
Vetippok leh dehave leh yom shellifne nikanor! amar rav ashe: hasheta ihu gufeh battelu, mishshum yom nikanor nekum venigzor?

May nikanor umay tureyaynos? detanya: nikanor, echad meipparche yevavnim haya, uvechol yom vayom haya menif yado al yehuda virushalayim, veomer: ematay tippol beyadi veermesenna. uchesheggavra malchut bet chashmonay venitztzechum, katztzu behonot yadav veraglav utelaum beshaare yerushalayim, veamru: pe shehaya medabber begaava, veyadayim shehayu menifot al yerushalayim — tease bahem nekama.

May tureyaynos? amru: keshebbikkesh tureyaynos laharog et luleyanus ufappus achiv beludekiyya, amar lahem: im meammo shel chananya mishael vaazarya attem — yavo elohechem veyatztzil etchem miyyadi, kederech shehitztzil et chananya mishael vaazarya miyyad nevuchadnetztzar! amru lo: chananya mishael vaazarya tzaddikim gemurin hayu, ureuyin hayu leasot lahem nes. unevuchadnetztzar melech hagun haya, verauy laasot nes al yado.

Veoto rasha, hedyot hu, veeno rauy laasot nes al yado. veanu nitchayyayvnu kelaya lammakom, veim en atta horgenu — harebe horgim yesh lo lammakom, veharebe dubbin vaarayot yesh lo lammakom beolamo sheppogin banu vehorgin otanu. ella, lo mesaranu hakkadosh baruch hu beyadcha, ella sheatid lippara damenu miyyadecha.
Af al pi chen haragan miyyad. amru: lo zazu mishsham, ad shebbau deyoppale meromi ufatzu et mocho begizrin.
En gozrin taanit al hatztzibbur battechilla bachamishi kulei, en gozrin taanit berashe chodashim kulei. vechamma havya hatechala? rav acha amar: shalosh. rabbi assi amar: achat.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: zo divre rabbi meir sheamar mishshum rabban gamliel, aval chachamim omrim: mitanne umashlim. daresh mar zutera mishshemeh derav huna: halacha mitanne umashlim.
Hadaran alach seder taaniyyot ketzad

Seder taaniyyot ellu, haamur birvia rishona. aval tzemachim sheshshanu — matriin alehen miyyad. vechen sheppasku geshamim ben geshem legeshem arbaim yom — matriin alehen, mippene shehi makkat batztzoret.

Yardu latztzemachin aval lo yardu lailan, leilan velo latztzemachin, laze velaze aval lo labborot lashshichin velammearot — matriin alehen miyyad. vechen ir shello yardu aleha geshamim, dichtiv: "vehimtarti al ir echat veal ir achat lo amtir chelka achat timmater vegomer".

a: Otah hair mitanna umatraat, vechol sevivoteha mitannot velo matriot. rabbi akiva omer: matriot velo mitannot. vechen ir sheyyesh bah dever o mappolet — otah hair mitanna umatraat, vechol sevivoteha mitannot velo matriot. rabbi akiva omer: matriot velo mitannot.
Ezehu dever? ir hammotzia chamesh meot ragli, veyatzu mimmenna shelosha metim bishlosha yamim ze achar ze — hare ze dever, pachot mikkan — en ze dever.
Al ellu matriin bechol makom: al hashshiddafon, veal hayyerakon, veal haarbe, veal hechasil, veal hachayya raa, veal hacherev — matriin aleha, mippene shehi makka mehallechet.

Maase sheyyardu zekenim mirushalayim learehem, vegazru taanit al shennira kimlo fi tannur shiddafon beashkelon. veod gazru taanit al sheachlu zeevim shene tinokot beever hayyarden. rabbi yose omer: lo al sheachlu, ella al shenniru.
Al ellu matriin beshabbat: al ir shehikkifuha nochrim o nahar, veal hassefina hammittarefet bayyam. rabbi yose omer: leezra velo litzaka. shimon hattimni omer: af al haddever, velo hodu lo chachamim.

Al kol tzara shello tavo al hatztzibbur matriin alehen, chutz merov geshamim. maase sheamru lo lechoni hameaggel, hitpallel sheyyerdu geshamim. amar lahem: tzeu vehachenisu tannure fesachim bishvil shello yimmoku. hitpallel velo yardu geshamim.

Ma asa? ag uga veamad betochah, veamar lefanav: ribbono shel olam! banecha samu penehem alay, sheani keven bayit lefanecha. nishba ani beshimcha haggadol sheeni zaz mikkan ad shetterachem al banecha. hitchilu geshamim menattefin. amar: lo kach shaalti, ella gishme borot shichin umearot. hitchilu lered bezaaf. amar: lo kach shaalti, ella gishme ratzon beracha unedava.

Yardu ketiknan, ad sheyyatzu yisrael mirushalayim lehar habbayit mippene haggeshamim. bau veamru lo: keshem shehitpallalta alehem sheyyerdu — kach hitpallel sheyyelchu lahen. amar lahem: tzeu ureu im nimchet even hattoin.

Shalach lo shimon ben shatach: ilmale choni atta — gozrani alecha nidduy. aval ma eese lecha, sheatta mitchatte lifne hammakom veose lecha retzoncha keven shehu mitchatte al aviv veose lo retzono, vealecha hakkatuv omer: "yismach avicha veimmecha vetagel yoladtecha".
Hayu mitannin veyardu lahem geshamim, kodem hanetz hachamma — lo yashlimu, leachar hanetz hachamma — yashlimu. rabbi eliezer omer: kodem chatzot — lo yashlimu, leachar chatzot — yashlimu.

Maase sheggazru taanit belod, veyardu lahem geshamim kodem chatzot. amar lahem rabbi tarfon: tzeu veichlu ushetu vaasu yom tov, veyatzu veachlu veshatu veasu yom tov, uvau ben haarbayim vekaru hallel haggadol.
Gemara seder taaniyyot haellu haamur birvia rishona. ureminhi: revia rishona usheniyya lishol, shelishit lehitannot!

Amar rav yehuda, hachi kaamar: seder taaniyyot haamur ematay — bizman sheyyatza revia rishona usheniyya ushelishit velo yardu geshamim. aval yardu geshamim birvia rishona vezaru velo tzamchu, i name tzamchu vechazru venishtannu — matriin alehen miyyad.
Amar rav nachman: davka nishtannu, aval yavshu — la. peshita, nishtannu tenan! la tzericha, daakun. mahu detema: akanta milleta hi, kamashma lan.
Vechen sheppasku geshamim ben geshem legeshem kulei. may makkat batztzoret? amar rav yehuda amar rav: makka hammevia lide batztzoret. amar rav nachman: nahara annahara —
b: Batztzureta. medinta ammedinta — kafna. veamar rabbi chanina: sea besela ushechicha — batztzureta. arbaa vela shechicha — kafna.

Amar rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella bizman shehammaot bezol uferot beyoker, aval maot beyoker uferot bezol — matriin aleha miyyad. deamar rabbi yochanan: nehirna kad havo kayymi arbea sein besela, vahavo nefishi nefiche chefan bitverya middelet issar.
Yardu latztzemachin aval lo lailan. bishlama latztzemachim velo lailan — mashkachat la daata nicha, vela atay razya. lailan velo latztzemachin — daatay razya, vela atay nicha.

Laze velaze aval lo labborot velo lashshichin umearot — mashkachat la daatay razya venicha, mihu tuva la atay. ella ha detanya: yardu levorot lashshichin velammearot aval lo laze velaze, hechi mashkachat la? daatay bishfichuta.
Tanu rabbanan: matriin al hailanot bifros happesach, al habborot veshichin umearot bifros hachag. veim en lahen mayim lishtot — matriin alehen miyyad.
Veezehu miyyad shellahen — sheni vachamishi vesheni. veal kullan en matriin alehen ella baipparchiyya shellahen.
Veaskara, bizman sheyyesh bah mita — matriin aleha. bizman sheen bah mita — en matriin aleha. umatriin al haggovay bechol shehu. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: af al hechagav.

Tanu rabbanan: matriin al hailanot bishar shene shavua. al habborot veal hashshichin veal hammearot afillu bashsheviit. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: af al hailanot bashsheviit, mippene sheyyesh bahen parnasa laaniyyim.

Tanya iddach: matriin al hailanot bishar shene shavua. al habborot al hashshichin veal hammearot afillu bashsheviit. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: af al hailanot. matriin al hassefichin bashsheviit, mippene sheyyesh bahen parnasa laaniyyim.

Tanya, amar rabbi elazar ben parta: miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash naasu geshamim tzimmukin laolam. yesh shana sheggeshameha merubbin, veyesh shana sheggeshameha muatin. yesh shana sheggeshameha yordin bizmannan, veyesh shana sheen geshameha yordin bizmannan.

Shana sheggeshameha yordin bizmannan lema hu dome — leeved shennatan lo rabbo parnasato beechad beshabbat, nimtzet issa neefet ketiknah, veneechelet ketiknah. shana sheen geshameha yordin bizmannan lema hu dome — leeved shennatan lo rabbo parnasato beerev shabbat, nimtzet issa neefet shello ketiknah, veneechelet shello ketiknah.

Shana sheggeshameha merubbin lema hu dome — leeved shennatan lo rabbo parnasato bevat achat, nimtzeu rechayim tochanot min hakkor ma shettochanot min hakkav, venimtzet issa ochelet min hakkor kemo [she]ochelet min hakkav.

Shana sheggeshameha muatin lema hu dome — leeved shennatan lo rabbo parnasato meat meat, nimtzeu rechayim ma shettochanot min hakkor tochanot min hakkav. nimtzet issa kamma shenneechelet min hakkor ochelet min hakkav.

Davar acher: bizman sheggeshameha merubbin lema hu dome — leadam shemmegabbel et hattit, im yesh lo mayim rabbim — mayim enan kalin, vehattit megubbal yafe. im yesh lo mayim muatin — mayim kalim, vehattit eno mitgabbel yafe.

Tanu rabbanan: paam achat alu kol yisrael laregel lirushalayim, velo haya lahem mayim lishtot. halach nakdimon ben gureyon etzel hegmon echad, amar lo: haleveni shetem esre maayaynot mayim leole regalim, vaani etten lach shetem esre enot mayim. veim eni noten lecha — hareni noten lach shetem esre kikkar kesef, vekava lo zeman.

Kevan shehiggia hazzeman velo yerdu geshamim, bashshacharit shalach lo: shagger li o mayim o maot sheyyesh li beyadcha. shalach lo: adayin yesh li zeman, kol hayyom kullo shelli hu. batztzohorayim shalach lo: shagger li o mayim o maot sheyyesh li beyadcha. shalach lo: adayin yesh li shehut bayyom. bammincha shalach lo: shagger li mayim o maot sheyyesh li beyadcha. shalach lo: adayin yesh li shehut bayyom. ligleg alav oto hegmon, amar: kol hashshana kullah lo yardu geshamim,

a: Veachshav yerdu geshamim?! nichnas levet hammerchatz besimcha. ad shehahegmon nichnas besimchato levet hammerchatz, nakdimon nichnas levet hammikdash keshehu atzuv. nitattef, veamad bitfilla.

Amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam! galuy veyadua lefanecha shello lichvodi asiti, velo lichvod bet abba asiti, ella lichvodcha asiti, sheyyehu mayim metzuyin leole regalim. miyyad nitkashsheru shamayim beavim, veyardu geshamim ad shennitmalleu shetem esre maayanot mayim vehotiru.

Ad sheyyatza hegmon mibbet hammerchatz, nakdimon ben gureyon yatza mibbet hammikdash. kesheppagu ze baze, amar lo: ten li deme mayim yoter sheyyesh li beyadcha! amar lo: yodea ani shello hirish hakkadosh baruch hu et olamo ella bishvilcha, ella adayin yesh li pitchon pe alecha, sheotzi mimmecha et meotayy, shekkevar shaka chamma, ugeshamim — birshuti yardu.

Chazar venichnas levet hammikdash, nitattef veamad bitfilla, veamar lefanav: ribbono shel olam! hoda sheyyesh lecha ahuvim beolamecha! miyyad nitpazzeru heavim vezarcha hachamma. beotah shaa amar lo oto hegmon: illu lo nikdera hachamma, haya li pitchon pe alecha sheotzi mimmecha meotayy. tana: lo nakdimon shemo, ella buni shemo, velamma nikra shemo nakdimon — shennikdera chamma baavuro.

Tanu rabbanan: shelosha nikdema lahem chamma baavuran: moshe, vihoshua, venakdimon ben gureyon. bishlama nakdimon ben gureyon — gemara. yehoshua — name kera, dichtiv: "vayyiddom hashshemesh veyareach amad vegomer". ella moshe menalan?
Amar rabbi elazar: atya "achel" "achel", ketiv hacha: "achel tet pachdecha", uchetiv hatam: "achel gaddelcha".
Rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar: atya "tet" "tet", ketiv hacha: "achel tet pachdecha", uchetiv hatam: "beyom tet Adonai et haemori".
Rabbi yochanan amar, atya miggufeh dikra: "asher yishmeun shimacha veragzu vechalu mippanecha", ematay ragzu vechalu mippanecha — beshaa shennikdema lo chamma lemoshe.
Vechen ir shello yardu aleha geshamim kulei. amar rav yehuda amar rav: ushetehen liklala.
"Hayta yerushalaym lenidda benehem", amar rav yehuda amar rav: livracha, kenidda: ma nidda yesh lah hetter — af yerushalayim yesh lah takkana.
"Hayta kealmana", amar rav yehuda, livracha: kealmana — velo almana mammash, ella keishsha shehalach balah limdinat hayyam, vedato lachazor aleha.
"Vegam ani natatti etchem nivzim ushefalim", amar rav yehuda: livracha, dela mokmi minnan la reshe nahare vela gezirippate.

"Vehikka Adonai et yisrael kaasher yanud hakkane bammayim", amar rav yehuda amar rav: livracha. deamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan, may dichtiv: "neemanim pitze ohev venatarot neshikot sone" — tova kelala shekkillel achiyya hashshiloni et yisrael yoter mibberacha shebberchan bilam harasha.

Achiyya hashshiloni killelan bekane, amar lahem leyisrael: "vehikka Adonai et yisrael kaasher yanud hakkane", ma kane ze omed bimkom mayim, vegizo machlif veshorashav merubbin, vaafillu kol haruchot shebbaolam baot venoshvot bo — en mezizot oto mimmekomo, ella holech uva immahen. dammu haruchot — amad hakkane bimkomo.

Aval bilam harasha berchan beerez, shenneemar: "kaarazim ale mayim", ma erez ze eno omed bimkom mayim, veen gizo machlif, veen shorashav merubbin. afillu kol haruchot shebbaolam noshvot bo — en mezizot oto mimmekomo. kevan shennashva bo ruach deromit — okarto vehofachto al panav. velo od ella shezzacha kane littol hemennu kulemos lichtov bo sefer tora neviim uchetuvim.

Tanu rabbanan: leolam yehe adam rach kekane veal yehe kashe keerez. maase shebba rabbi elazar berabbi shimon mimmigdal gedor mibbet rabbo, vehaya rachuv al chamor umetayyel al sefat nahar, vesameach simcha gedola. vehayta dato gassa alav mippene shellamad tora harebe.
b: Nizdammen lo adam echad shehaya mechoar beyoter. amar lo: shalom alecha rabbi! velo hechzir lo. amar lo: reka, kamma mechoar oto haish! shemma kol bene irecha mechoarin kemotcha? amar lo: eni yodea, ella lech veemor laumman sheasaani: "kamma mechoar keli ze sheasita". kevan sheyyada beatzmo shechata, yarad min hachamor venishtattach lefanav, veamar lo: naaneti lecha, mechol li! amar lo: eni mochel lecha ad shettelech laumman sheasaani veemor lo: kamma mechoar keli ze sheasita.

Haya metayyel acharav ad shehiggia leiro. yatzu bene iro likrato, vehayu omrim lo: shalom alecha rabbi rabbi, mori mori! amar lahem: lemi attem korin rabbi rabbi? amru lo: leze shemmetayyel acharecha. amar lahem: im ze rabbi — al yirbu kemoto beyisrael. amru lo: mippene ma? amar lahem: kach vechach asa li. amru lo: af al pi ken, mechol lo, sheadam gadol betora hu.

Amar lahem: bishvilchem hareni mochel lo, uvilvad shello yehe ragil laasot ken. miyyad nichnas rabbi elazar berabbi shimon, vedarash: leolam yehe adam rach kekane veal yehe kashe keerez. ulefichach zacha kane littol hemennu kulemos lichtov bo sefer tora tefillin umezuzot.
Vechen ir sheyyesh bah dever o mappolet kulei. tanu rabbanan: mappolet sheamru, beriot velo reuot. sheenan reuyot lippol, velo haruyot lippol.
He nihu beriot, he nihu sheenan reuyot lippol. he nihu reuot, he nihu reuyot lippol! la tzericha, dinfalu mechamat guvehayyhu. i name, dekayyman aggudda denahara.

Ki hahi ashita reiata dahavay binhardea dela hava chalef rav ushemuel tuta, af al gav dekayyma beatra telesar shenin. yoma chad ikkela rav adda bar ahava lehatam, amar leh shemuel lerav: nete mar nakkef! amar leh: la tzerichna haiddana, deikka rav adda bar ahava bahadan dinfisha[1] zechuteh, vela mistefena.
Rav huna hava leh hahu chamra behahu beta reia, uvea lefannoyeh. ayyeyleh lerav adda bar ahava lehatam, mashcheh bishmata ad defanneyeh. batar dinfak nefal beta. argesh rav adda bar ahava, ikkefad.

Savar la ki ha deamar rabbi yannay: leolam al yaamod adam bemakom sakkana veyomar: osin li nes, shemma en osin lo nes. veim timtze lomar osin lo nes — menakkin lo mizzechiyyotav. amar rav chanan: may kera — dichtiv: "katonti mikkol hachasadim umikkol haemet".

May hava ovadeh derav adda bar ahava? ki ha deittemar, shaalu talmidav lerav adda bar ahava: bamma heerachta yamim? amar lahem: miyyamay lo hikpadti betoch beti, velo tzaadti bifne mi sheggadol mimmenni,

Velo hirharti bimvoot hametunnafot, velo halachti arba ammot belo tora uvelo tefillin, velo yashanti bevet hammidrash lo shenat keva velo shenat aray, velo sasti betakkalat chaveray, velo karati lachaveri bahachinato, veamri la bachanichato.

Amar leh rava lerafram bar pappa: lema lan mar mehane mille mealleyayta dahava aved rav huna! amar leh: beyankuteh la dechirna, besevuteh dechirna. dechol yoma deeva havo mappekin leh beguharka dedahava, vesayayr la lechulla mata. vechol ashita dahavot reiata, hava satar la. i efshar lemara — bane la, vei la efshar — bane la ihu middideh.

Vechol panya demaale shabbeta hava meshaddar shelucha leshuka, vechol yarka dahava payesh lehu leginnae, zabben leh veshade leh lenahara. velitteveh laaniyyim! zimnin desamcha datayyhu vela atu lemizban. velishdeyeh livhema! kasavar: maachal adam en maachilin livhema.
Vela lizbeneh kelal! nimtzeta machshilan leatid lavo.

Ki hava leh milleta deasuta, hava male kuza (demayya) [minneh], vetale leh besippa deveta, veamar: kol devae lete velishkol. veikka deamri: milleta deshivta hava gemir, vahava mannach kuza demayya vedale leh, veamar: kol ditzrich — lete veleul dela listakkan.
Ki hava karech rifta, hava patach levaveh, veamar: kol man ditzrich lete velechol. amar rava: kullehu matzena mekayyaymna, levar meha dela matzena lemibad,

a: Mishshum dinfishi bene chela demachoza.

Ilfa verabbi yochanan havo garsi beorayyta, dechika lehu milleta tuva, amri: nekum venezil venebad iska unekayyem benafshin "efes ki lo yihye becha evyon". azalu, otivu tute gudda reia, havo ka karchi rifta, ato tere malache hashsharet.

Shameh rabbi yochanan deamar chad lechavreh: nishde alayyhu hay gudda veniktelinhu, shemmannichin chayye olam habba veoskin bechayye shaa! amar leh iddach: shavkinhu, deikka behu chad dekayyma leh shata. rabbi yochanan shema, ilfa la shema. amar leh rabbi yochanan leilfa: shama mar midde? amar leh: la. amar middishmai ana veilfa la shema, shema minna ledidi kayyma li shata.
Amar leh rabbi yochanan: ehedar, veoke benafshay "ki lo yechdal evyon mikkerev haaretz". rabbi yochanan hadar, ilfa la hadar. ad daata ilfa, malech rabbi yochanan.

Amru lo: i ittiv mar vegares, la hava malech mar. azal tela nafsheh beaskarya disfinta, amar: i ikka deshael li bematnita derabbi chiyyay verabbi oshaya vela pashetna leh mimmatnitin, nafelna measkarya disfinta vetavana.
Ata hahu sava, tena leh: haomer tenu shekel levanayy beshabbat, vehen reuyin latet lahem sela — notnin lahem sela. veim amar: al tittenu lahem ella shekel — en notnin lahem ella shekel.
Im amar: im metu yirshu acherim tachtehem — ben sheamar "tenu" ben sheamar "al tittenu" — en notnin lahem ella shekel. amar leh: ha manni — rabbi meir hi, deamar: mitzva lekayyem divre hammet.

Amru alav al nachum ish gam zo shehaya some mishte enav, giddem mishte yadav, kittea mishte raglav, vechol gufo male shechin. vehaya muttal bevayit raua, veragle mittato munnachin bisfalin shel mayim kede shello yaalu alav nemalim. paam achat bikkeshu talmidav lefannot mittato, veachar kach lefannot et hakkelim. amar lahem: banayy, pannu et hakkelim, veachar kach pannu et mittati, shemmuvetach lachem shekkol zeman sheani babbayit en habbayit nofel. pinnu et hakkelim veachar kach pinnu et mittato, venafal habbayit.

Amru lo talmidav: rabbi, vechi meachar shetztzaddik gamur atta, lama alta lecha kach? amar lahem: banayy, ani garamti leatzmi. sheppaam achat hayiti mehallech badderech levet chami, vehaya immi massoy shelosha chamorim, echad shel maachol, veechad shel mishte, veechad shel mine megadim. ba ani echad veamad li badderech, veamar li: rabbi, parneseni. amarti lo: hameten ad sheefrok min hachamor. lo hispakti lifrok min hachamor ad sheyyatzta nishmato.

Halachti venafalti al panav, veamarti: enay shello chasu al enecha — yissomu, yadayy shello chasu al yadecha — yitgaddemu, raglay shello chasu al raglecha — yitkatteu. velo nitkarra dati ad sheamarti: kol gufi yehe male shechin. amru lo: oy lanu sherinucha bechach! amar lahem: oy li im lo reituni bechach.

Veammay karu leh nachum ish gam zo — dechol milleta dahava salka leh, amar: gam zo letova. zimna chada beo leshaddore yisrael doron leve kesar, amru: man yezil — yezil nachum ish gam zo, dimlummad benissin hu. shaddaru bideh mele sifta daavanim tovot umargaliyyot. azal, bat behahu dira. belelya kamu hanach dayorae veshaklinhu lesifteh umelonhu afra.

Ki meta hatam, sherinhu lesifte, chazanhu dimlu afra. bea malka lemiktelinhu lechullehu, amar: ka mechayyeychu bi yehudae. amar: gam zo letova. ata eliyyahu iddemi leh kechad minnayyhu, amar leh: dilma ha afra meafra deavraham avuhon hu, dechi hava shade afra — havu sayyfe, gile — havu gire, dichtiv: "yitten keafar charbo kekash niddaf kashto".
Haveya chada medinta dela matzu lemichbesha, bedaku minneh vechavshuha. ayaylu leve ginze umelohu lesifteh avanim tovot umargaliyyot, veshadderuhu bikara rabba.

Ki ato, bitu behahu diyyura, amaru leh: may ayytet bahadach deavdi lach yekara kulle hay? amar lehu: may dishkali mehacha amti lehatam. setaru ledirayyhu veamtinhu leve malka, amaru leh: hay afra deayyti hacha — middidan hu. badku vela ashkechu, vekatlinhu lehanach dayorae.

I zo hi dever — ir hammotzia chamesh meot ragli kulei. tanu rabbanan: ir hammotzia chamesh meot veelef ragli, kegon kefar akko, veyatzu hemenna tisha metim bishlosha yamim ze achar ze — hare ze dever.
Beyom echad o bearbaa yamim — en ze dever. veir hammotzia chamesh meot ragli, kegon kefar amiku, veyatzu hemenna shelosha metim bishlosha yamim ze achar ze — hare ze dever.
b: Beyom echad o bearbaa yamim — en ze dever.
Derokeret, ir hammotzia chamesh meot ragli havay, veyatzu mimmenna shelosha metim beyom echad. gezar rav nachman bar rav chisda taanita. amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: keman — kerabbi meir,
Deamar: richek negichotav — chayyayv, kerav negichotav — lo kol shekken?!

Amar leh rav nachman bar rav chisda lerav nachman bar yitzchak: lekum mar lete legabban. amar leh: tenena, rabbi yose omer: lo mekomo shel adam mechabbedo, ella adam mechabbed et mekomo. shekken matzinu behar sinay, shekkol zeman shehashshechina sheruya alav, amra tora: "gam hatztzon vehabbakar al yiru el mul hahar hahu", nistalleka shechina mimmennu, amra tora: "bimshoch hayyovel hemma yaalu vahar".
Vechen matzinu beohel moed shebbammidbar, shekkol zeman shehu natuy amra tora: "vishallechu min hammachane kol tzarua", hugellu happarochot — hutteru zavin umetzoraim likkanes sham.
Amar leh: i hachi, nekum ana legabbe mar. amar leh: mutav yavo mane ben peras etzel mane ben mane, veal yavo mane ben mane etzel mane ben peras.

Besura havot devarta, beshivavuteh derav la havot devarta. sevur minna, mishshum zechuteh derav dinfish. itchazi lehu bechelma: rav dinfisha zechuteh tuva — ha milleta zutera leh lerav. ella, mishshum hahu gavra dimshayyel mara uzevila likvura.

Bidrokeret havot delekta, uveshivavuteh derav huna la havot delekta. sevur minna, bizchuta derav huna dinfish. itchazi lehu bechelma: hay zutera leh lerav huna, ella mishshum hahi itteta dimchammema tannura umeshayyeyla leshivavutay.
Amaru leh lerav yehuda: ato kamtze. gezar taanita. amaru leh: la ka mafsedan. amar lehu: zevode ayyto bahadayyhu?
Amaru leh lerav yehuda: ikka motana bachazire. gezar taanita. nema kasavar rav yehuda makka meshullachat mimmin echad meshullachat mikkol hamminin? la, shane chazire — dedomyayn meayyhu livne inashe.
Amaru leh lishmuel: ikka motana be chozae. gezar taanita. amri leh: veha merachak! amar: lekka mabara hacha defasek leh.
Amaru leh lerav nachman: ikka motana beara deyisrael. gezar taanita amar: im gevira loka, shifcha lo kol shekken!
Tama digvira veshifcha, ha shifcha veshifcha — la. veha amaru leh lishmuel: ikka motana be chozae, gezar taanita! shane hatam, kevan deikka shayyayrata delavvivy veatya bahadeh.

Abba ummana hava ate leh shelama mimmetivta dirkia kol yoma, uleabbaye kol maale yoma deshabbeta, lerava kol maale yoma dechippure. hava ka chalsha dateh deabbaye mishshum deabba ummana. amaru leh: la matzet lemibad keovadeh.

Umay havo ovadeh deabba ummana — dechi hava aved milleta, hava machet gavre lechod venashe lechod, veit leh levusha deit beh karna dahavot bezia ki chusilta. ki havot atya leh itteta, hava malbesh lah ki hechi dela nistakkal bah. veit leh ducheta ditznia deshade beh peshite deshakel, deit leh — shade beh, delet leh — la mikkesif.

Ki hava itreme leh tzureba merabbanan, agra minneh la shakel. uvatar dekae, yahev leh peshite vaamar leh: zil avri nafshach. yoma chad shaddar abbaye zuga derabbanan lemivdekeh. otvinhu veochlinhu veashkinhu umach lehu bistarki belelya.

a: Letzafra, karchinhu veshaklinhu vekamu unefaku lehu leshuka veashkechinhu. amaru leh: leshayyeymeh mar hechi shavu. amar lehu: hachi vehachi. amaru leh: vedilma shavu tefe? amar lehu: behachi (shaklinhu) [shekali lehu]. amaru leh: didach nihu veshaklinhu minnach.

Amaru leh: bematuta minnach bemay chashadtinnan? amar lehu: amena, pidyon shevuyim ikkela lehu lerabbanan, veikkesifu lememar li. amaru leh: hasheta nishkelinhu mar! amar lehu: mehahu shata assachtinhu middatay litzdaka.
Hava ka chalsha dateh derava mishshum deabbaye, amaru leh: missatyaych deka maggenayt akkulle karcha.

Rabbi beroka chozaa hava shechiach beshuka deve lafat. hava shechiach eliyyahu gabbeh, amar leh: ikka behay shuka bar alma deate? amar leh: la. addehachi vehachi chaza lehahu gavra dahava sayem mesane ukkame vela reme chuta ditchelta biglimeh. amar leh: hay bar alma deate hu.

Rehat batreh, amar leh: may ovadach? amar leh: zil haiddana, veta limchar. limchar amar leh: may ovadach? amar leh: zandukena ana, veasarna gavre lechod venashe lechod, veramena pureyayy ben hane lehane ki hechi dela leto lide issura. ki chazena bat yisrael deyahavi nochrim ala enayyhu, masarna nafshay umatztzelna la. yoma chad havot naara meorasa gabban dihavu bah nochrim enayyhu, shekali duredyay dechamra usheday la beshippula, vaamari: dashtana hi.

Amar leh: may tama let lach chute, uremet mesane ukkame? amar leh: ayelna venafekna bene nochrim, ki hechi dela liddeu dihudaa ana. ki havu gazri gezerta, modana lehu lerabbanan uvau rachame umevatteli ligzertayyhu. umay tama ki amena lach ana may ovadach, vaamart li: zil haiddana veta limchar? amar leh: behahi shata gazri gezerta, veamena: beresha ezil veeshmea[], veeshlach lehu lerabbanan delivo rachame ala demilleta.

Addehachi vehachi ato hanach tere ache. amar leh: hanach name bene alma deate ninhu. azal legabbayyhu, amar lehu: may ovadayychu? amaru leh: inashe badoche anan, mevaddechinan atzive. i name, ki chazenan be tere deit lehu tigra bahadayyhu, tarchinan veavdinan lehu shelama.

Al ellu matriin bechol makom kulei. tanu rabbanan, al ellu matriin bechol makom: al hashshiddafon, veal hayyerakon, veal arbe vechasil, veal chayya raa. rabbi akiva omer: al hashshiddafon veal hayyerakon bechol shehu. arbe vechasil, afillu lo nira beeretz yisrael ella kanaf echad — matriin alehen.

Veal chayya vechulei. tanu rabbanan: chayya raa sheamru, bizman shehi meshullachat — matriin aleha, enah meshullachat — en matriin aleha. e zo hi meshullachat vee zo hi sheenah meshullachat? niret bair — meshullachat, bassade — enah meshullachat. bayyom — meshullachat, ballayla — enah meshullachat.

Raata shene bene adam veratzta acharehen — meshullachat. nechbet mippenehen — enah meshullachat. tarfa shene bene adam veachla echad mehen — meshullachat. achla shenehen — enah meshullachat. alta laggag venatla tinok mearisa — meshullachat.
Ha gufa kashya, amrat: nirata bair — meshullachat; la shena bayyom vela shena ballayla. vahadar amrat: bayyom — meshullachat, ballayla — enah meshullachat!
La kashya, hachi kaamar: nirata bair bayyom — meshullachat. bair ballayla — enah meshullachat. i name bassade, afillu bayyom — enah meshullachat. (bassade, ballayla — enah meshullachat).
Raata shene bene adam veratzta acharehen — meshullachat, ha omedet — enah meshullachat. vahadar amrat: nechbet mippenehen — enah meshullachat, ha omedet — meshullachat!
La kashya: kan — besade hassemucha laagam, kan — besade sheenah semucha laagam.
Tarfa shene bene adam keechad veachla echad mehen — meshullachat, shenehem — enah meshullachat. veha amrat afillu ratzta! amar rav pappa: ki tane hahi, beagma.
Gufa: alta laggag venatla tinok mearisa — meshullachat. peshita! amar rav pappa: kechuche detzayyayde.

Al hacherev vechulei. tanu rabbanan: cherev sheamru, eno tzarich lomar cherev sheeno shel shalom, ella afillu cherev shel shalom. sheen lecha cherev shel shalom yoter mipparo necho, veaf al pi chen nichshal bah hammelech yoshiyyahu, shenneemar:
b: "Vayyishlach elav malachim lemor ma li valach melech yehuda lo alecha atta hayyom ki el bet milchamti velohim amar levahaleni chadal lecha meelohim asher immi veal yashchitecha".
May: "elohim asher immi"? amar rav yehuda amar rav: zo avoda zara. amar: hoil veka batach baavoda zara — yachelna leh.
"Vayyoru hayyorim lammelech yoshiyyahu vayyomer hammelech laavadav haaviruni ki hocholeti meod", may "ki hocholeti meod"? amar rav yehuda amar rav: melammed sheasu kol gufo kichvara.
Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: mippene ma neenash yoshiyyahu — mippene shehaya lo limmalech beyirmeyahu velo nimlach. may derash: "vecherev lo taavor beartzechem",
May "cherev"? illema cherev sheenah shel shalom, vehachtiv: "venatatti shalom baaretz"! ella afillu shel shalom. vehu eno yodea sheen doro dome yafe.

Ki hava nicha nafsheh, chaza yirmeyahu sifvoteh deka merachashan, amar: shemma chas veshalom milleta dela mehaggena amar aggav tzaareh. gechen veshameh deka matzdek aleh dina annafsheh, amar: "tzaddik hu Adonai ki fihu mariti". petach aleh hahi shata: "ruach appenu meshiach Adonai".
Maase veyardu zekenim mirushalayim learehem kulei. ibbaya lehu: kimlo tannur tevua, o dilma kimlo tannur pat.
Ta shema: kimlo fi tannur. vaadayin tibbee lehu: kechissuya detannura, o dilma ki dara derifta dehadar leh lefumma detannura? teku.

Veod gazru taanit al sheachlu zeevim kulei. amar ulla mishshum rabbi shimon ben yehotzadak: maase uvalu zeevim shene tinokot vehekium derech bet hari. uva maase lifne chachamim, vetiharu et habbasar, vetimmeu et haatzamot.

Al ellu matriin beshabbat kulei. tanu rabbanan: ir shehikkifuha nochrim o nahar, veechad sefina hammittarefet bayyam, veechad yachid shennirdaf mippene nochrim o mippene listin umippene ruach raa — matriin beshabbat. veal kullan yachid rashshay lesaggef et atzmo betaanit.

Rabbi yose omer: en hayyachid rashshay lesaggef et atzmo betaanit, shemma yitztarech labberiyyot veen habberiyyot merachamot alav. amar rav yehuda amar rav: may tama derabbi yose — dichtiv: "vayhi haadam lenefesh chayya" — neshama shennatatti becha hacheye.
Shimon hattimni omer: af al haddever kulei. ibbaya lehu: lo hodu lo chachamim bashshabbat, aval bachol — hodu lo, o dilma: lo hodu lo kelal?
Ta shema, detanya: matriin al haddever bashshabbat, veen tzarich lomar bachol. rabbi chanan ben pitom talmido shel rabbi akiva mishshum rabbi akiva omer: en matriin al haddever kol ikkar.

Al kol tzara shello tavo al hatztzibbur kulei. tanu rabbanan: al kol tzara shello tavo al hatztzibbur matriin aleha, chutz merov geshamim. may tama? amar rabbi yochanan: lefi sheen mitpallelin al rov hattova.

Veamar rabbi yochanan: minnayin sheen mitpallelin al rov hattova, shenneemar: "haviu et kol hammaaser el bet haotzar vegomer". may "ad beli day"? amar rame bar rav yod: ad sheyyivlu siftotechem millomar "day".

Amar rame bar rav yod: uvaggola, matriin aleha. tanya name hachi: shana sheggeshameha merubbin, anshe mishmar sholchin leanshe maamad: tenu enechem baachechem shebbaggola, shello yehe battehem kivrehem.
Shaalu et rabbi eliezer: ad hechan geshamim yordin veyitpallelu shello yerdu? amar lahem: kede sheyyaamod adam bekeren afel vishachshech raglav bammayim. vehatanya: "yadav"! raglav keyadav kaamena.
Amar rabba bar bar chana: ledidi chazya li keren afel, dekam hahu tayyaya ki rechiv gamla venaket rumecha bideh mitchaze iniva.
Tanu rabbanan: "venatatti gishmechem beittam", lo shikkora, velo tzemea, ella benonit. shekkol zeman shehaggeshamim merubbin — metashteshin et haaretz veenah motziah perot. davar acher:
